elements.definition: Contacting the originator of whether the warranty claim has been approved or rejected.

elements.name: Authorize payment
elements.definition: Allowing for a payment to be made to the claimant.

elements.name: Close claim
elements.definition: Archiving and closing the warranty claim after a final decision has been made to either approve or reject.

elements.name: Reconcile warranty transaction disposition
elements.definition: Assuring that the warranty transaction has been completed.

elements.name: Manage supplier recovery
elements.definition: Managing the recovery of costs from suppliers for individual claims.

elements.name: Create supplier recovery claims
elements.definition: Raising a supplier recovery claim. This is based off the decision made in Receive investigation result/recommendation for corrective action [20100].

elements.name: Negotiate recoveries with suppliers
elements.definition: Arranging the returns of recalled products to suppliers.

elements.name: Service products
elements.definition: Validating specific service requirements for individual customers. Determine and schedule resource to fulfill these requirements. Provide service to specific individual customers. Ensure the quality of service delivery.

elements.name: Confirm specific service requirements for individual customer
elements.definition: Acquiring or soliciting information about specific service requirements for individual customers through the customer service function. Obtain information about customer specific requests, process these requests, and create customer profiles to generate a service order.

elements.name: Process customer request
elements.definition: Soliciting or acquiring information using various sources such as databases, customer interactions, and customer request forms. Hand them further up the hierarchy to deal with them. Categorize the user's request, determining if the request is supportable and prioritizing the request.

elements.name: Create customer profile
elements.definition: Documenting the individual customer service requirements solicited, along with personal information of the customers, in order to generate customized profiles that hasten the delivery process.

elements.name: Generate service order
elements.definition: Designing a short-term agreement between the service provider and customer. One-time services are ordered by the service recipient and resource-related billing is performed upon completion. Use the service order to document service and customer service work.

elements.name: Identify and schedule resources to meet service requirements
elements.definition: Determining and scheduling the resources required to fulfill customer service requirements. Create a detailed schedule about the service orders and development of these service orders.

elements.name: Create resourcing plan and schedule
elements.definition: Developing a plan for sourcing and deploying the resources required to fulfill customer service needs. Document a detailed summary of all types of resources (equipment, finance, personnel, time, etc.) required to complete customer service requests and procure these resources. Identify and assess various sources in order to effectively create a resourcing plan.

elements.name: Create service order fulfillment schedule
elements.definition: Designing a detailed summary of customer service order requirements, along with information concerning the timing and duration for these services. Categorize the customer needs. Monitor the services delivered.

elements.name: Provide service to specific customers
elements.definition: Dispatching resources for managing and fulfilling daily service requirements. Manage the progress of order fulfillment. Complete order blocks.

elements.name: Organize daily service order fulfillment schedule
elements.definition: Laying out a daily plan of specific service orders that need to be fulfilled. Document and systematically order these activities to ensure high effectiveness and efficiency.

elements.name: Execute product repair
elements.definition: Dispatching and delivering the resources needed for the specific service requirements from the source/warehouse. Manage the dispatch, transportation, and delivery of the services.

elements.name: Manage service order fulfillment
elements.definition: Handling and managing orders fulfilled, along with the orders are not or partially fulfilled to track the order fulfillment progress. Use electronic devices such as trackers and GPS in order track and ensure delivery of the orders.

elements.name: Ensure quality of service
elements.definition: Guaranteeing the quality of service provided to customers. Identify the successful and unsuccessful orders along with the service failures. Collect customer feedback. Process the feedback to ensure the quality of service in the future.

elements.name: Identify completed service orders for feedback
elements.definition: Determining the service orders that have been successfully delivered. Identify the service orders completed and delivered to the customer. Leverage communication systems to ensure coordination with the customers in order to avoid mishaps.

elements.name: Identify incomplete service orders and service failures
elements.definition: Determining orders which have not been completed or delivered. Identify the service orders that are partially or entirely incomplete, as well as the orders that have not been delivered to the customer. Use techniques such as project trackers to recognize the progress of the service orders.

elements.name: Solicit customer feedback on services delivered
elements.definition: Obtaining and procuring customer reviews or feedback on the services delivered. Design a customer feedback form, or communicate with the customer through the phone or online.

elements.name: Process customer feedback on services delivered
elements.definition: Assessing and incorporating customer reviews/feedback into the service plan to ensure high quality of service.

elements.name: Manage product recalls and regulatory audits
elements.definition: Removing defective products from the distribution chain. Participate in audits from watchdog agencies.

elements.name: Initiate recall
elements.definition: Commencing the removal process of defective products.

elements.name: Assess the likelihood and consequences of occurrence of any hazards
elements.definition: Performing risk analysis. Identify all dangers, evaluate how probable they are, and what kinds of negative results or or adverse side effect they carry.

elements.name: Manage recall related communications
elements.definition: Handling communications that are related to product recalls.

elements.name: Submit regulatory reports
elements.definition: Creating and delivering reports to regulatory agencies to provide details about handling product recalls.

elements.name: Monitor and audit recall effectiveness
elements.definition: Analyzing the effectiveness of product recalls.

elements.name: Manage recall termination
elements.definition: Ending product recalls, communicating to the public and filing reports.

elements.name: Evaluate customer service operations and customer satisfaction
elements.definition: Calculating and assessing the operational activities of the customer service function. Evaluation is achieved through the customer requests/inquiries handling process, the customer complaint handling process, and product and services quality. Examine activities to ensure high levels of customer service.

elements.name: Measure customer satisfaction with customer problems, requests, and inquiries handling
elements.definition: Calculating satisfaction levels of customers by effectively evaluating the process of handling requests/inquiries of customers. Effectively calculate the performance of customer-requests/inquiries handling and resolution. Obtain information regarding requests/inquiries handling and resolution through customer feedback. Use it to explore new ideas and opportunities for enhanced customer requests/inquiries handling and resolution process.
elements.change_details: +11687, +11688, +18126, -10404, -10406, -10407, RENAME, WAS:Measure customer satisfaction with customer requests/inquiries handling
elements.renamed_was: Measure customer satisfaction with customer requests/inquiries handling

elements.name: Solicit customer feedback on customer service experience
elements.definition: Creating an avenue for which the customer can provide feedback on their experience with how their inquiry, problem, or request was handled.

elements.name: Analyze customer service data and identify improvement opportunities
elements.definition: Reviewing customer service feedback to identify areas in which improvements can be made. Engage with management to discuss issues.

elements.name: Provide customer feedback to product management on customer service experience
elements.definition: Handing over data to management to analyze common issues in regards to customer service.

elements.name: Measure customer satisfaction with customer- complaint handling and resolution
elements.definition: Measuring the satisfaction level of customers as pertains to how their complaints are handled and resolved. This process element requires the organization to estimate the customers level of fulfillment with the process reconciling their complaints and towards the objective of ensuring customer retention. The feedback received can be used to develop concepts for new opportunities to boost the level of customer satisfaction.
elements.change_details: +11689, RENAME, WAS:Measure customer satisfaction with customer-complaint handling and resolution
elements.renamed_was: Measure customer satisfaction with customer-complaint handling and resolution

elements.name: Solicit customer feedback on complaint handling and resolution
elements.definition: Requesting customer feedback on the process of handling and resolving customer complaints. Obtain information about the effectiveness and performance of the customer complaint handling process from the customers through various means (e.g., online and by phone).

elements.name: Analyze customer complaint data and identify improvement opportunities
elements.definition: Examining the information obtained through handling and resolving complaints for development/improvement opportunities. Categorize the customer complaints data on the basis of speed, accuracy, courtesy, price, product choice, availability, hours, location, etc. Determine complaint patterns in order to diagnose areas needing enhancement.

elements.name: Identify common customer complaints
elements.definition: Determining complaint patterns in order to identify common issues. Document common problems for correction.

elements.name: Measure customer satisfaction with products and services
elements.definition: Calculating satisfaction levels of customers with products/services. Obtain customer feedback on products/services, as well as the effectiveness of the advertising campaigns. Examine this information to reach meaningful conclusions, which could then be used to enhance the customer service operations.
elements.change_details: +20117, c11238, c11239, c11240, c11241, RENAME, WAS:Measure patient satisfaction with services

elements.name: Gather and solicit post-sale customer feedback on products and services
elements.definition: Obtaining customer feedback/review on the quality and utility derived from the products/services after the sale is complete. Use techniques such as surveys, feedback boxes, and user activity and usability tests.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Gather and solicitpatient feedback on services
elements.renamed_was: Gather and solicitpatient feedback on services

elements.name: Solicit post-sale customer feedback on ad effectiveness
elements.definition: Assessing the influence of advertisements on purchasing behavior. Use techniques such as surveys and product recognition tests, questionnaires or feedback flyers, and toll-free numbers in order to encourage customer interaction after the sale.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Solicit patient feedback on pre- and post- care communication effectiveness
elements.renamed_was: Solicit patient feedback on pre- and post- care communication effectiveness

elements.name: Solicit customer feedback on cross-channel experience
elements.definition: Engaging with the customer to understand their cross-channel experience. Find out what channels were effective and what areas need improvement.

elements.name: Analyze product and service satisfaction data and identify improvement opportunities
elements.definition: Assessing the information collected on customer satisfaction levels with products/services in order to determine areas for improvement. Examine the data and information extracted from the customer feedback and reviews to measure the satisfaction levels of the customers. Identify opportunities that could enhance the customer satisfaction levels and the overall customer service strategy.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Analyze satisfaction data and identify improvement opportunities
elements.renamed_was: Analyze satisfaction data and identify improvement opportunities

elements.name: Provide feedback and insights to appropriate teams (product design/development, marketing, manufacturing)
elements.definition: Providing feedback from customers on products/services to the product management team. Analyze information collected through Gather and solicit post-sale customer feedback on products/services [11238]. Share with the product management team for consideration while improving existing offerings or developing new products/services.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Provide patient feedback to individual departments and providers for their services
elements.renamed_was: Provide patient feedback to individual departments and providers for their services

elements.name: Evaluate and manage warranty performance
elements.definition: Assessing the cost and effectiveness of warranties.

elements.name: Measure customer satisfaction with warranty handling and resolution
elements.definition: Evaluating how satisfied customers are with how product warranties are managed and resolved.

elements.name: Monitor and report on warranty management metrics
elements.definition: Comparing warranties by using using applicable metrics to see how they are handled and resolved. Develop and submit reports that summarize significant conclusions.

elements.name: Identify improvement opportunities
elements.definition: Determining how warranties and warranty management can be made better and more efficient.

elements.name: Identify opportunities to eliminate warranty waste
elements.definition: Finding ways to phase out unused or seldom used warranties.

elements.name: Investigate fraudulent claims
elements.definition: Reviewing and assessing claims that contain deliberately incorrect information or that have been submitted with the goal to deceive the system.

elements.name: Evaluate recall performance
elements.definition: Reviewing customer service feedback to identify areas in which improvements can be made. Engage with management to discuss issues.

elements.name: Develop and Manage Human Capital
elements.definition: Delivering processes traditionally defined as "human resources". Process groups include those related to developing and maintaining workforce strategy, recruiting employees, developing and counseling employees, managing employee relations, rewarding and retaining employees, redeploying and retiring employees, managing employee information, and managing employee communications.

elements.name: Develop and manage human resources planning, policies, and strategies
elements.definition: Creating strategies for the HR function. Create and implement strategies for managing the work force. Supervise and enhance the strategies, plans, and policies supporting the HR function. Developing models for managing competency levels of the HR of the organization.
elements.change_details: +20958, +17045, -10416, -17044, RENAME, WAS:Develop and manage human resources (HR) planning, policies, and strategies
elements.renamed_was: Develop and manage human resources (HR) planning, policies, and strategies

elements.name: Develop human resources strategy
elements.definition: Creating a long-term plan to associate human resource requirements with the strategic goals of the company to ensure that there is enough qualified staffing to achieve those goals, to maintain competitive advantage and to reduce employee turnover.

elements.name: Identify strategic HR needs
elements.definition: Strategically defining the current and future needs for developing an efficient HR strategy.

elements.name: Define HR and business function roles and accountability
elements.definition: Outlining the charge and duty of the HR function by defining its responsibility areas, as well as ensuring its accountability. Establish the HR function by laying out the roles and responsibilities for this function and the rules and regulations guiding HR. Define the goals and objectives of the HR, as well as a mission and vision for this function. Create a mechanism involving a set of policies, code of conduct, and institutional procedure to ensure HR accountability.

elements.name: Determine HR costs
elements.definition: Ascertaining the costs and expenses of the HR function. Identify and report HR investments using, for example, a cost approach or a present value of future earnings approach.

elements.name: Establish HR measures
elements.definition: Evaluating the performance of HR function. Lay out the course of HR procedures that would formulate a plan of action needed to fulfill strategic HR needs. Deploy measures such as hiring policies, leave management, internal code of conducts, and compensation structure.

elements.name: Communicate HR strategies
elements.definition: Conveying the strategies of HR function to employees and management. Effectively explain the vision, plans, and anticipated benefits of the HR strategy employees, as well as the public. Develop statements and messages that are easy to read, informative, and relevant to the audience.

elements.name: Develop strategy for HR systems/technologies/tools
elements.definition: Creating a strategy for the use of systems/technologies/tools in operating the HR function. Create a strategy concerning the use and utility of HR support tools and technologies. Decide what specific tools to use and in what quantity. Determine the levels of technology required for the HR management.

elements.name: Manage employer branding
elements.definition: Creating, maintaining and communicating company's reputation and values to keep current employees and attract potential hires.

elements.name: Develop and implement workforce strategy and policies
elements.definition: Creating and executing strategies and policies for smooth administration of work force. Determine and gather skill requirements. Plan the requirements for employee resourcing per unit. Create compensation, succession, HR program, and employee diversity plans. Develop and administer policies for HR. Develop benefits for employees. Create models for work force strategies.

elements.name: Gather skill requirements according to corporate strategy and market environment
elements.definition: Evaluating the current and future skill requirements of the organization with regard to the overall corporate strategy of the organization and market conditions. Identify and establish the minimum skills needed for the requisite HR needs.

elements.name: Plan employee resourcing requirements per business unit/organization
elements.definition: Determining the requirements for employees and the need for employee resourcing for each every unit/function. Lay out a plan detailing employee resourcing requirements of individual functions and the organization as a whole.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Plan employee resourcing requirements per unit/organization
elements.renamed_was: Plan employee resourcing requirements per unit/organization

elements.name: Develop compensation plan
elements.definition: Designing a plan that specifies the combination of wages, salaries, and benefits the employees receive in exchange for work. Define the total amount of compensation, in addition to the manner in which the compensation is paid and the purposes for which employees can receive bonuses, salary increases, and incentives.

elements.name: Establish incentive plan
elements.definition: Creating a scheme of awards and recognition for sales employees to promote a results-based culture. Create specific incentives to reach desired outcomes, such as landing key clients, growing the customer base, providing exceptional servicing, and increasing profit margins.

elements.name: Develop succession plan
elements.definition: Creating and implementing the plan for continuation of key positions within the organization. Identify internal people with the potential to fill key business leadership positions. Provide critical development experiences to employees who can move into important roles. Engage leaders to support the development of high-potential leaders.

elements.name: Develop high performers/leadership programs
elements.definition: Creating a program that incorporates incentives and compensation put forth by the organization to recognize high performing workers and excellence in leadership.

elements.name: Develop employee diversity plan
elements.definition: Creating and implementing the plan for ensuring a diverse work force. Develop and hire employees with varying characteristics including, but not limited to, religious and political beliefs, gender, ethnicity, education, socioeconomic background, sexual orientation, and geographic location.

elements.name: Develop training program
elements.definition: Identifying skills, knowledge, and attributes that need enhancement in order to perform a job. Develop the appropriate training programs. These programs can be computer-based, classroom, or on-the-job training, etc.

elements.name: Develop recruitment program
elements.definition: Developing a program to entice prospective resources to engage with the organization for a position of employment.

elements.name: Develop other HR programs
elements.definition: Creating HR programs and services such as employee engagements programs to promote positive employee behavior. Create a variety of programs and services to support employees' professional and personal needs at work and at home.

elements.name: Develop HR policies
elements.definition: Creating rules and regulations that govern the HR function. Develop a policy plan that serves as a guideline for setting rules and regulations that help in achieving the HR goals and objectives.

elements.name: Administer HR policies
elements.definition: Ensuring rules and regulations are followed and are flexible enough to accommodate indispensable deviations.

elements.name: Plan employee benefits
elements.definition: Planning benefits in kind (also called fringe benefits, perquisites, or perks). Include various types of non-wage compensations provided to employees in addition to normal wages or salaries.

elements.name: Develop workforce strategy models
elements.definition: Creating and implementing models for effectively strategizing the work force of the organization. Develop a model that specifies the organization's overall approach for maximizing the performance of its work force by defining the goals, objectives, and expectations of the work force. Manage all aspects of performance required for the work force to function, including recruitment, selection, retention, and professional development.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Develop work force strategy models

elements.name: Implement workforce strategy models
elements.definition: Implementing models for effectively strategizing the work force of the organization. Carry out all aspects of performance required for the work force to function, including recruitment, selection, retention, and professional development.

elements.name: Monitor and update strategy, plans, and policies
elements.definition: Supervising the HR strategy, plans, and policies in order to refurbish them whenever needed. Determine the performance of HR plans and policies by measuring the objective achievement rate and its contribution to the overall business strategy. Ensure that information about these plans and strategies is effectively communicated to various stakeholders. Incorporate any suggestions by these stakeholders when revising HR plans and policies.

elements.name: Measure realization of objectives
elements.definition: Determining the accomplishment of HR goals and objectives. Evaluate the effectiveness of the HR function by estimating the present rate of achievement of the established objectives. Use metrics to determine if the objectives are being realized. Leverage measures such as turnover, training, return on human capital, costs of labor, and expenses per employee.

elements.name: Measure contribution to business strategy
elements.definition: Determining the role of HR function in implementing the organizational strategy. Measure the correlation between the HR performance and the overall business strategy. Calculate the amount of contribution of the HR function to the overall business growth.

elements.name: Communicate plans and provide updates to stakeholders
elements.definition: Conveying the plans for HR function to stakeholders. Ensure that the HR plans and strategy are effectively communicated to the people who can affect or be affected by the organization's actions, objectives, and policies such as the creditors, shareholders, employees, and suppliers. Provide regular updates to these stakeholders to ensure effective communication.

elements.name: Review and revise HR plans
elements.definition: Reassessing the strategies, plans, and policies of the HR function, with the objective of revising them. Revisit the schematic plans for the HR function. Taking stock of any suggestions or feedback from the stakeholders, revamp the blueprint of HR strategies and plans.

elements.name: Develop competency management models
elements.definition: Creating and implementing the tools for managing the competency levels of HR. Design a model for integrating HR planning with business planning. Assess current HR capacity based on the competencies against the capacity needed to achieve the vision, mission, and business goals of the organization. Consider factors such as employee development, career path, compensation policies, and performance management.

elements.name: Recruit, source, and select employees
elements.definition: Determining and handling employee requirements. Recruit or source the candidates as per the requirements. Screen and select the most appropriate candidates. Take care of the newly hired and re-hired employees. Maintain records of information for all applicants.

elements.name: Manage employee requisitions
elements.definition: Handling the requirements for new employees. Create and open job requisitions by clearly defining the job descriptions. Post these requirements internally and externally, and modify them as appropriate. Manage the dates of the whole requisition process.

elements.name: Align staffing plan to work force plan and business unit strategies/resource needs
elements.definition: Creating a correspondence between the plan for hiring new employees and the desired employee requirements. Staff an adequate amount of people with the appropriate skills to effectively accomplish its legislative, regulatory, service, and production requirements.

elements.name: Develop and maintain job descriptions
elements.definition: Creating descriptions for job requisitions. Define the normal components of a job description, such as the overall position description with general areas of responsibility listed, essential functions of the job described with a couple of examples of each, required knowledge, skills, abilities, required education and experience, a description of the physical demands, and a description of the work environment.

elements.name: Open job requisitions
elements.definition: Developing specific job requisitions, and ensuring their accessibility. Create and open a job requisition to fill the vacant positions within the organization. Clearly describe the job title, department, fill date, and the requisite skills and qualifications for the job.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Develop and open job requisitions

elements.name: Post job requisitions
elements.definition: Posting and advertising job descriptions. Display open job descriptions internally and externally. Use public portals, online portals, and websites to upload these requisitions in order for applications to be received.

elements.name: Modify job requisitions
elements.definition: Making the necessary alterations to job requisitions. Revamp or revise the job requisitions in case a position is filled or is not vacant anymore, as well as in case of any new openings. (It involves Manage the internal/external job posting websites [10449] to make the necessary changes.)

elements.name: Notify hiring manager
elements.definition: Informing and communicating with the hiring manager. Notify the manager responsible for the hiring process in cases of any new position openings or changes.

elements.name: Manage requisition dates
elements.definition: Determining and managing the dates for the employee requisition process.

elements.name: Recruit/Source candidates
elements.definition: Recruiting new candidates for deployment across various functional areas inside the organization. Select methods for sourcing new employees. Manage relationships with third-party agencies. Stage recruitment fairs and drives. Manage employee referral programs.

elements.name: Determine recruitment methods and channels
elements.definition: Defining the methods and channels for recruitments in order to maximize the amount of candidate availability. Use channels such as headhunting, job postings, job portals, networking websites, and media advertising. Choose from the various methods of recruitment such as internal/external third-party sourcing.

elements.name: Perform recruiting activities/events
elements.definition: Organizing and executing recruiting activities and events. Activities and events include on-campus hiring, refresher courses, information sessions, career fairs, etc. to increase the coverage of the sourcing in order to ensure that the most deserving and appropriate candidates are hired.

elements.name: Manage recruitment vendors
elements.definition: Establishing and maintaining relationships with recruitment vendors (suppliers). Create and maintain relationships with third-party agencies such as staffing and firms to expand. Use these relationships to implement the sourcing process effectively.

elements.name: Manage employee referral programs
elements.definition: Creating and managing a recruiting strategy where current employees are rewarded for referring qualified candidates for employment.

elements.name: Manage recruitment channels
elements.definition: Establishing and maintaining channels for recruiting. Extract the best out of every recruitment channel. Manage all the processes related to all the sourcing channels.

elements.name: Screen and select candidates
elements.definition: Evaluating and selecting potential employees through interviews, tests, etc.

elements.name: Identify and deploy candidate selection tools
elements.definition: Identifying and implementing tools for the selection of candidates. Recognize candidate selection tools such as screening, telephone interviews, hiring manager interviews, drug testing, and skills assessment. Effectively deploy these tools to check if the candidates fit in the workplace or not, as well as to ensure workplace safety.

elements.name: Interview candidates
elements.definition: Assessing the candidates by their performance in the interviews. Conduct HR interview, technical interview, hiring manager interview, etc. Understand the mindset of the candidate, and comprehend his/her personal and professional lives.

elements.name: Test candidates
elements.definition: Examining the candidates through tests. Prepare tools such as aptitude, technical, and grammar tests. Test the skills of the candidate through a written, oral, or computerized test.

elements.name: Validate candidates medical practice certification
elements.definition: Validating the applicable medical practice privileges by the state and medical certification requirements from the appropriate credentialing board.

elements.name: Select and reject candidates
elements.definition: Approving the deserving candidates, and rejecting the others. Examining the performance of candidates. Ensure candidates would fit well with the organization. (Assess performance from Interview candidates [10457] and Test candidates [10458].)

elements.name: Manage new hire/re-hire
elements.definition: Creating and making job offers to the selected candidates. Fairly negotiate the job offers. Agree on terms with the candidate to complete the hiring process.

elements.name: Draw up and make offer
elements.definition: Compiling job-related information for the selected candidates in order to make up a job. Include information about the job description, reporting relationship, salary, bonus potential, benefits, and vacation allotment.

elements.name: Negotiate offer
elements.definition: Negotiating an offer with selected candidates. Discuss the job offer with the candidate to ensure a mutual understanding.

elements.name: Hire candidate
elements.definition: Wrapping up the process for hiring candidates. Agree to all hiring terms and conditions. Have the candidate accept and sign the job offer.

elements.name: Manage applicant information
elements.definition: Creating and maintaining a system for managing the information of applicants. Create records for all candidates who apply. Maintain and track information through the use applicant-tracking systems.

elements.name: Obtain candidate background information
elements.definition: Conducting a background investigation on the candidates with the objective of looking up and compiling criminal, commercial, and financial records.

elements.name: Create applicant record
elements.definition: Creating and documenting the records of all applicants. Manage all individual applicants, including hires and non-hires. Maintain records to avoid any duplication and promote efficiency.

elements.name: Manage/track applicant data
elements.definition: Keeping track of all the information about the candidates who apply for jobs. Use applicant-tracking systems that can be accessed online as a central location and database for recruitment efforts.

elements.name: Complete position classification and level of experience
elements.definition: Identifying the requirements for the position to be filled. Determine the experience and skills necessary to perform the tasks outlined.

elements.name: Archive and retain records of non-hires
elements.definition: Retaining and storing the records of the candidates who were rejected and not hired to ensure future availability in case the need arises. Create a centralized repository of profiles. Label these records in order to readily identify them. Add remarks for any future consideration.

elements.name: Manage employee on-boarding, development, and training
elements.definition: Assisting employees in developing their capabilities, and providing them counseling services. Handle the orientation and deployment of the employees. Administer the performance of employees. Administer the development and enhancement of the employees. Provide training and development programs for employees.

elements.name: Manage employee orientation and deployment
elements.definition: Creating and maintaining various employee on-boarding programs typically known as induction programs in order to ensure that the new employees are effectively introduced to the organization and its existing employees. Examine and evaluate the performance of these induction programs. Execute these programs on the ground level.

elements.name: Create/maintain employee on-boarding program
elements.definition: Creating and maintaining a mechanism through which new employees acquire the necessary knowledge, skills, and behaviors to become effective organizational members and insiders. Conduct formal meetings, lectures, videos, printed materials, and/or computer-based orientations to introduce newcomers to their new jobs and the organization.

elements.name: Develop employee induction program
elements.definition: Designing a program to systematically introduce newly hired employees to the organizational culture of the company.

elements.name: Maintain/Update employee induction program
elements.definition: Managing the orientation and training of new employees about the organizational culture of the company.

elements.name: Evaluate the effectiveness of the employee on-boarding program
elements.definition: Assessing the performance and effectiveness of employee on-boarding program. Examine the performance of on-boarding program through feedback and reviews from the new employees. Create web and written forms. Obtain information through face-to-face discussions.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Evaluate the effectiveness of employee on-boarding program
elements.renamed_was: Evaluate the effectiveness of employee on-boarding program

elements.name: Execute on-boarding program
elements.definition: Bringing the employee on-boarding program into effect. Implement Create/Maintain employee on-boarding program [10474]. Conduct training sessions and employee engagement programs.

elements.name: Manage employee performance
elements.definition: Defining individual performance objectives. Review performance in order to provide appraisals. Evaluate the efficiency and effectiveness of the current performance program. Update it regularly.

elements.name: Define employee performance objectives
elements.definition: Outlining the objectives for employee performance. Establish key performance objectives and measures such as customer-focus objectives, financially focused objectives, and employee growth objectives.

elements.name: Review, appraise, and manage employee performance
elements.definition: Refurbishing, appraising, and managing the performance of employees. Create performance reviews for all the employees by qualitatively and quantitatively measuring them. Use the reviews to provide performance appraisals. Monitor under-performing employees.

elements.name: Evaluate and review performance program
elements.definition: Assessing and revamping performance programs, including the instruments used to measure employee performance standards. Review and upgrade these performance programs to avoid any deprivations and ensure effectiveness.

elements.name: Manage employee development
elements.definition: Establishing employee development guidelines. Lay out career paths and plans for them. Manage the development of their skills to enhance their skills, ability, and knowledge.

elements.name: Define employee development guidelines
elements.definition: Outlining the guidelines for development of employees. Design development policies and procedures to identify areas of growth for employees, either in their current position or in preparation for future roles. Include topics related to knowledge and skill development.

elements.name: Develop employee career plans and career paths
elements.definition: Designing a future career path for the employees that encourages them to explore and gather information.

elements.name: Manage employee skill and competency development
elements.definition: Administering the development of employee skills. Conduct training, coaching and mentoring, job-rotation and cross training, lateral moves, etc.

elements.name: Track continuing medical education credits
elements.definition: Keeping current with continuing medical education credits is important and a system should be put in place to let individuals know when they need to be recertified, etc.

elements.name: Develop and train employees
elements.definition: Creating a link between employee and organizational development needs. Conduct and manage employee training programs by considering the need and availability of these programs.

elements.name: Align employee with organization development needs
elements.definition: Aligning the needs of the employees to development needs.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Align employee and organization development needs
elements.renamed_was: Align employee and organization development needs

elements.name: Define employee competencies
elements.definition: Defining the skills, knowledge, abilities, and attributes needed to carry out a specific job.

elements.name: Align learning programs with competencies
elements.definition: Aligning the learning programs with the core capabilities and competencies of the organization. Contextualize the training programs so that employees can expand their knowledge base and add new skills in line with the core competencies of the organization.

elements.name: Establish training needs by analysis of required and available skills
elements.definition: Determining the training necessitated by business processes, using an examination of skill sets that are needed by the organization and those already possessed. Examine the various skills required by individual employees. Design training in light of the availability of resources to provide specific segments of training.

elements.name: Develop, conduct, and manage employee and/or management training programs
elements.definition: Creating, implementing, and managing the programs for training employees. Create and design sessions on the basis of the needs and the availability of the skills. Conduct the sessions on the ground. Manage all aspects related to the training programs. Consider including literacy training, interpersonal skills training, technical training, problem-solving training, diversity or sensitivity training, etc.

elements.name: Manage examinations and certifications
elements.definition: Managing identified training programs for employees. Engage with industries to provide certifications, administer certification test, and maintain active certification.

elements.name: Liaise with external certification authorities
elements.definition: Coordinating with third party certification authorities to provide training and certifications for necessary skills.

elements.name: Administer certification tests
elements.definition: Providing tests to the workforce that will satisfy completion of certifications.

elements.name: Appraise experience qualifications
elements.definition: Ascertaining the experience level needed to qualify for a specific job or certification within the organization. Some certificates require practical experience as well as training programs.

elements.name: Administer certificate issue and maintenance
elements.definition: Administering certificates to all candidates that have successfully met experience qualifications, and passed all tests necessary to obtain the certificate.

elements.name: Estimate workload
elements.definition: Forecasting work orders to plan the number and expertise of staff that will be needed.

elements.name: Schedule labor
elements.definition: Using predefined rules to automatically optimize the schedule and use of resources.

elements.name: Approve overtime
elements.definition: Approving the amount of time someone works beyond normal working hours. Labor laws have been established for those not on salary.

elements.name: Manage health care provider workforce
elements.definition: Managing the workforce in regards to the forecasting of workload and required staff, involvement of employees into the scheduling process, time management, and analysis and monitoring of process.

elements.name: Monitor and adjust labor level
elements.definition: Monitoring and adjusting labor based on level of activity within the organization. Forecasting should be used as a planning technique.

elements.name: Manage employee relations
elements.definition: Assisting general management in developing, maintaining, and improving employee relationships. This is accomplished through communication, performance management, processing grievances, and/or dispute. Interpret and convey organizational policies.

elements.name: Manage labor relations
elements.definition: Managing labor relations, the collective bargaining process, and the relationships between the labor and management. Take care of employee grievances.

elements.name: Manage collective bargaining process
elements.definition: Managing any negotiations between an employer and a group of employees that determine the conditions of employment. Engage employees to reach agreements in regulating working conditions.

elements.name: Manage labor management partnerships
elements.definition: Handling partnerships between labor and management. Develop a lasting two-way relationship that is beneficial for the labor, management, and the organization.

elements.name: Manage employee grievances
elements.definition: Taking care or resolving any complaint raised by an employee by procedures provided for in a collective agreement, an employment contract, or by other mechanisms established by an employer.

elements.name: Reward and retain employees
elements.definition: Creating frameworks for rewarding and recognizing employees with the objective of retaining them. Create and manage programs for provision of rewards, recognition, and motivation. Manage and administer the benefits for employees. Help assist and retain employees. Administer payroll to employees.

elements.name: Develop and manage reward, recognition, and motivation programs
elements.definition: Developing a salary/compensation structure and plan; developing a benefits and reward plan; develop commission plan; performing competitive analyses of benefits and rewards; identifying compensation requirements based on compensation, benefits, and HR policies; administering compensation, commission, and rewards to employees; and rewarding and motivating employees.

elements.name: Develop salary/compensation structure and plan
elements.definition: Creating the framework for the provision of salary/compensation to employees. Break down the salary structure into different components such as fixed pay, variable pay, bonus, and allowances such medical allowance, and rent allowance, etc. Develop, adjust, and maintain a pay structure.

elements.name: Develop benefits and rewards plan
elements.definition: Developing a plan for provision of rewards, commission, and benefits to employees. Plan health benefits, retirement benefits, non-monetary benefits, etc.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Develop benefits and reward plan

elements.name: Perform competitive analysis of benefits and rewards
elements.definition: Analyzing and evaluating the organization's benefits and rewards plan. Compare/Benchmark the benefits and employees plan with other organizations to adhere to industry standard practices.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Perform competitive analysis of benefit and rewards
elements.renamed_was: Perform competitive analysis of benefit and rewards

elements.name: Identify compensation requirements based on financial, benefits, and HR policies
elements.definition: Recognizing the employee requirements for compensation on the basis of the financial, benefits, and HR policies of the organization. Recognize individual compensation requirements regarding the financial policies of the organization. Consider the benefits plan and overall HR policies while selecting compensation requirements.

elements.name: Administer compensation and rewards to employees
elements.definition: Managing the provision of compensations and rewards to the employees while maintaining consistency with the compensation and benefits plan. Follow the compensation and benefits plan rigorously in order to avoid any discrepancies.

elements.name: Reward and motivate employees
elements.definition: Rewarding and stimulating the performance efforts of employees. Create methods for motivating employees. Spur extrinsic and intrinsic motivation.

elements.name: Manage and administer benefits
elements.definition: Managing and ensuring benefits enrollment by the employees. Process any benefit claims made by the employees. Balance the estimated amount and entitled amount of benefits.

elements.name: Deliver employee benefits program
elements.definition: Implementing the programs that specify employee benefits, other than salary provided, such as those concerning medical care, death, and disability.

elements.name: Administer benefit enrollment
elements.definition: Handling the employee enrollment for obtaining benefits. Manage employee enrollment and eligibility. Encourage employees to enroll for benefits.

elements.name: Process claims
elements.definition: Processing any formal requests or demands made by the employees claiming that they have earned some benefits. Send the request further up the managerial hierarchy to ensure approval.

elements.name: Perform benefit reconciliation
elements.definition: Carrying out reconciliation of benefits delivered to employees. Compare the estimated benefit requirement made by the employee and the actual amount of benefits the employee is entitled to receive.

elements.name: Manage employee assistance and retention
elements.definition: Managing activities centered around delivering programs to support work/life balance for employees; developing family support systems; reviewing retention and motivation indicators; and reviewing compensation plans.

elements.name: Deliver programs to support work/life balance for employees
elements.definition: Designing programs that prompt proper balance between work (i.e., career and ambition) and lifestyle (i.e., health, pleasure, leisure, family, and spiritual development/meditation). Account for dependent care, flexible working arrangements, leaves of absence, on-the-job training, etc.

elements.name: Develop family support systems
elements.definition: Creating a support structure that aligns with local and federal laws that allow for support for families. This could include things like maternity leave, care for a family member, or in some cases, extended sick leave.

elements.name: Review retention and motivation indicators
elements.definition: Reassessing the indicators for retention and motivation of employees. Monitor the indicators that signal the levels of motivation and retention. Regularly update and upgrade indicators to avoid depreciation and ensure high efficiency.

elements.name: Review compensation plan
elements.definition: Analyzing existing compensation plans and making changes necessary to continue to retain employees.

elements.name: Administer payroll
elements.definition: Managing the sum of all financial records of salaries for an employee, including wages, bonuses, and deductions. Use a payroll management system to deal with the financial aspects of employees' salaries, allowances, deductions, gross pay, net pay, etc. Generate pay slips for a specific period.

elements.name: Redeploy and retire employees
elements.definition: Managing the reassignment and retirement of employees. Manage the process of employee promotion and demotion. Administer separation, retirement, and leaves of absence. Outplace employees. Deploy personnel. Relocate employees in order to manage assignments.

elements.name: Manage promotion and demotion process
elements.definition: Administering the process of promoting and demoting employees. Design a system for advancing or demoting an employee's rank or position. Leverage techniques such as horizontal promotion, vertical promotion, dry promotion, and involuntary/voluntary demotion.

elements.name: Manage separation
elements.definition: Managing the process of employee separation, including resignations, discharges, and layoffs. Inform the employee of the termination. Complete paperwork for continuation of benefits.

elements.name: Manage retirement
elements.definition: Managing and administering instances where a person stops employment completely.

elements.name: Manage leave of absence
elements.definition: Managing the period of time that an employee must be away from their primary job, while maintaining the status of employee (i.e., paid and unpaid leave of absence but not vacations, holidays, hiatuses, sabbaticals, and work-from-home programs).

elements.name: Develop and implement employee outplacement
elements.definition: Helping former employees transition to new jobs or to re-orient themselves in the job market. Deliver help through one-on-one sessions or in a group format. Provide guidance in career evaluation, resume writing, interview preparation, developing networks, and job searching.

elements.name: Manage workforce scheduling
elements.definition: Organizing the workforce so that all positions are covered for all shifts with the necessary skilled resources in place. Have a system in place to backfill positions while an employee is on leave.

elements.name: Receive required resources/skills and capabilities
elements.definition: Obtaining resources necessary to fill a position utilizing specific skills and capabilities.

elements.name: Manage resource deployment
elements.definition: Allocating employees. Deploy personnel to ensure that the labor of the organization is continuously in an optimal relation to the jobs and organizational structure.

elements.name: Relocate employees and manage assignments
elements.definition: Managing the relocation of employees in order to carry out assignments. Manage internal business processes to transfer employees, their families, and/or entire departments of a business to a new location.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Relocate employees, and manage assignments

elements.name: Manage expatriates
elements.definition: Managing foreign resources. Manage employees who are sent to live abroad for a defined time period, as well as non-native employees.

elements.name: Manage employee information and analytics
elements.definition: Managing the employee reporting processes, employee inquiry process, employee information and data, and the HR information systems. Create and administer the employee metrics. Develop and handle the time and attendance systems. Refurbish the indicators for employee retention and motivation.

elements.name: Manage reporting processes
elements.definition: Providing information and reports regarding employees to management.

elements.name: Manage employee inquiry process
elements.definition: Handling instances where an employee believes that he/she has been inappropriately treated or he/she desires clarification. Encourage employees to inquire when needed. Record and clarify the issues for which the enquiry has been made.

elements.name: Manage and maintain employee data
elements.definition: Capturing and updating employee information and data and information on the employees.

elements.name: Manage human resource information systems HRIS
elements.definition: Administering and maintaining HR information systems that take care of activities related to HR, accounting, management, and payroll.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Manage human resource information systems (HRIS)

elements.name: Develop and manage employee metrics
elements.definition: Creating and maintaining performance metrics for employees. Create and manage a strategic system of data and statistics to accurately gauge each employee's information. Consider productivity metrics, efficiency metrics, training metrics, etc.

elements.name: Develop and manage time and attendance systems
elements.definition: Developing and maintaining systems for managing the time and attendance of employees. Routinely upgrade the process and systems that track when employees start and stop work, the department where the work is performed, attendance in addition to tracking meals and breaks, the type of work performed, and the number of items produced.

elements.name: Manage/Collect employee suggestions and perform employee research
elements.definition: Procuring and handling suggestions from employees, and performing research on employees. Manage and analyze the programs that help the organization to tap into employee ideas for improving the organization's processes and/or products. Use surveys, focus groups, and other data-gathering methods to find out the attitudes, opinions, and feelings of members of an organization.

elements.name: Manage employee communication
elements.definition: Creating an effective plan that initiates and promotes communication and engagement among the employees and between employees and management.

elements.name: Develop employee communication plan
elements.definition: Creating a plan for managing communication among employees. Inform employees of direction. Counter resistance with change management approaches. Seek specific areas of input to the decision-making process. Seek varying degrees of involvement and co-creation.

elements.name: Conduct employee engagement surveys
elements.definition: Questioning employees to ascertain overall workplace satisfaction.

elements.name: Deliver employee communications
elements.definition: Implementing the communication plan for employees. Initiate dialogues and engagement by monitoring the exchange of ideas and opinions, the development of personal relationships, etc.

elements.name: Manage Information Technology (IT)
elements.definition: Managing process groups relevant to the business of information technology within an organization. The process groups include "Develop and manage IT customer relationships", "Develop and manage IT business strategy", " Develop and manage IT resilience and risk", " Manage information", " Develop and manage services/solutions", "Deploy services/solutions", and " Create and manage support services/solutions".

elements.name: Develop and manage IT customer relationships
elements.definition: Creating and administering relationships with IT customers. Understanding customer needs including high-level business requirements for IT transformation. Plan for and communicate IT services along with establishing IT service levels, providing transformation guidance, and performance analysis that foster IT customer relationships.

elements.name: Understand IT customer needs
elements.definition: Assessing the customer communities along with current IT operational capabilities and usage.

elements.name: Understand IT customer communities
elements.definition: Interacting with IT customers to understand the IT needs through a collaborative community through involvement, connection, and informed communication.

elements.name: Assess IT customer operational capabilities
elements.definition: Evaluate the ability of the group of staff dependent on information technology, to align resources and critical processes according to organizational vision being able to deliver effectively and efficiently.

elements.name: Identify IT customer transformation needs
elements.definition: Identifying changing needs of staff dependent on information technology based on continuous improvement to deliver results according to organizational goals.

elements.name: Understand business requirements for IT capabilities
elements.definition: Understanding business requirements for the existing IT environment as well as future IT needs.

elements.name: Understand IT landscape
elements.definition: Understanding the complete logical structure and working of the organization's IT landscape. Assess the configuration of hardware and software (IT Assets) across the organization that supports overall business operations.

elements.name: Develop IT visioning
elements.definition: Developing goals to define IT vision. Define and document ideas, direction, and activities which enable information technology to reach these goals.

elements.name: Outline IT service expectations
elements.definition: Defining a roadmap to meet organizational expectations from information technology services while considering how it will affect the business.

elements.name: Plan and communicate IT services
elements.definition: Create and design an organized and curated collection of all IT-related services that can be performed by, for, or within the organization. Maintain and convey information about deliverables, prices, contact points, and processes for requesting an information technology service.

elements.name: Manage IT customer expectations
elements.definition: Managing customer expectations of the existing IT environment while considering how it will affect the business.

elements.name: Define future IT services
elements.definition: Defining the expected demand and usage of information technology services to meet organization's future business goals. Gather necessary information about the processes, resource requirements, and structures pertaining to planned business growth.

elements.name: Determine  IT performance indicators
elements.definition: Determining IT KPIs crucial to the organization's success. Measure indicators such as IT costs as percentage of revenue, IT maintenance ratio, and system downtime in an effort to evaluate the performance of IT across the organization.

elements.name: Create IT marketing messages
elements.definition: Developing concise statements that position the value proposition around the pressing concerns of the internal IT user base, thereby showing how the IT offerings are the right fit for a segment of IT customers.

elements.name: Create IT service marketing plan
elements.definition: Creating a marketing strategy for IT offerings to customers. Plan processes for making budgets; identifying and developing media; and managing marketing content and promotional activities.

elements.name: Provide IT transformation guidance
elements.definition: Understanding the necessity of IT transformation for the business. Collect and analyze customer requirements. Identify opportunities and prioritize outcomes. Develop and support business case for transformation. Develop transformation plan and roadmap.

elements.name: Develop IT transformation plans
elements.definition: Developing a robust plan to replace or upgrade an organization's information technology systems. Understanding the business need of IT transformation from current to an expected state for the business. Developing a strategic plan for IT operating model, governance, service delivery, and workforce transformation.

elements.name: Collect IT customer requirements
elements.definition: Identifying existing or potential IT gaps between the expected business performance levels and current business outcomes.

elements.name: Analyze IT customer requirements
elements.definition: Assessing identified IT gaps to plan for remediation efforts to allow outcomes to meet established performance levels.

elements.name: Identify and prioritize IT opportunities
elements.definition: Identifying IT opportunities on the basis of collection and analysis of IT customer requirements, then prioritize the identified IT opportunities on the basis of their importance.

elements.name: Facilitate solution design activities
elements.definition: Providing a plan of action to provide solution to IT customers. The solution design should be based on the collection and analysis of IT customer requirements.

elements.name: Prioritize IT outcomes
elements.definition: Prioritizing IT outcomes based on need, effectiveness, and efficiency.

elements.name: Develop business cases
elements.definition: Create a business case with value proposition indicating current situation, proposed solution, financial analysis, and measurable benefits to the IT customers.

elements.name: Support business case
elements.definition: Supporting business case with supporting research, business analysis, and background information on IT transformation.

elements.name: Develop transformation roadmap
elements.definition: Creating a blueprint for execution of IT transformation from the existing state to the planned organizational structure based on the value proposition and projected business growth.

elements.name: Develop and manage IT service levels
elements.definition: Establishing and maintaining service levels for the provision of IT services and solutions. Design and maintain the IT services and solution catalogue, as well as service level agreements. Evaluate the performance of IT service level agreements. Communicate the results to the management.

elements.name: Understand IT service requirements
elements.definition: Understand requirements related to information technology services considering enterprise-level effects and understand potential achievements in the business environment.

elements.name: Forecast IT service demand
elements.definition: Forecasting demand for IT services using current business growth, research, and customer feedback. Refine these forecasts, inspect the approach used in creating forecasts, and determine its accuracy.

elements.name: Maintain IT services catalog
elements.definition: Maintain information about IT deliverables, prices, contact points, and processes for requesting a service.

elements.name: Define service level agreement
elements.definition: Designing and maintaining commitment of service by performance evaluation of IT services and communicate the results to the management.

elements.name: Maintain IT customer contracts
elements.definition: Maintaining and documenting commitment of service to staff for information technology contracts including providing software or hardware solution through communication channels like phone, email, and on-site services.

elements.name: Negotiate and establish service level agreements
elements.definition: Establish a service level agreement, which is a negotiated agreement designed to create a common understanding about services, priorities, and responsibilities.

elements.name: Develop and maintain improvement processes
elements.definition: Conveying the improvement opportunities for the business and level of IT services. Leverage the results obtained from the performance metrics of the business and IT service levels to identify and recognize any opportunities that would improve or enhance the efficiency of the business and IT service-level structure. Communicate these opportunities to management in order for the improvements to take effect.

elements.name: Manage IT customer relationships
elements.definition: Managing the IT relationship with its customers by systematically coordinating interactions over multiple touch points on a regular basis. Coordinate the IT's efforts to reach out to its customers, which include emails, social-media interactions, newsletters, and direct conversations.

elements.name: Establish relationship management mechanisms
elements.definition: Create mechanisms for effective public relationship in order to preserve the image and goodwill of the organization through the process.

elements.name: Understand IT customer strategy
elements.definition: Understanding the strategy for staff dependent on information technology. Create a plan to create services and solutions, conduct daily operations, and train new employees.

elements.name: Understand  IT customer environment
elements.definition: Understanding the environment of staff dependent on information technology. Assess and evaluate services and solutions used by customers to conduct daily operations, and train new employees.

elements.name: Communicate IT capabilities
elements.definition: Conveying the goals and objectives of the IT function and how it contributes to the overall business objectives to staff and departments across the organization.

elements.name: Manage IT requirements
elements.definition: Managing the IT requirements for business objectives. Identify the requirements of hardware and software equipment to store, retrieve, transmit, and manipulate data related to business operations. Consider factors such as functional, design, growth phases, and delivery schedule while managing IT requirements.

elements.name: Analyze service performance
elements.definition: Proactively manage IT service levels against IT customer requirements.

elements.name: Assess SLA compliance
elements.definition: Gather data from each service target defined in an SLA for a time segment or review period to evaluate an overall performance percentage.

elements.name: Triage SLA compliance issues
elements.definition: Prioritizing SLA compliance issues and plan for remediation.

elements.name: Collect feedback about IT products and services
elements.definition: Collecting customer feedback about IT products and services effectiveness based on overall satisfaction. The data is collected through surveys, customer responses, and feedbacks based on the delivered products/services.

elements.name: Synthesize and distribute IT performance information
elements.definition: Providing stakeholders with collected IT performance measures for further development based on evaluation.

elements.name: Develop and manage IT business strategy
elements.definition: Handling the business of IT. Create a organization-wide strategy for the IT function. Define the organization's IT architecture. Manage the IT portfolio. Research and innovate in the field of IT. Assess and convey the performance and the value of the IT function.

elements.name: Define business technology and governance strategy
elements.definition: Defining the need of technology in business and systematic implementation of IT investments. It comprises of assessing competitive technology components to ensure structural analysis, development, usage and security of technology for efficient business operations.

elements.name: Build and maintain IT strategic intelligence
elements.definition: Building and maintaining intelligence towards changing organizational goals, supporting management, and operational or functional levels of the business. It is the ability to understand business trends that present threats or opportunities for IT in an organization.

elements.name: Monitor and map current and emerging technologies
elements.definition: Monitoring and evaluating existing and forthcoming technologies to meet the current and future growth plans for business operations.

elements.name: Define and communicate digital transformation strategy
elements.definition: Defining the integration of digital technology into business operations and service delivery, and convey the strategy to different segments of business. It is always backed by continuous improvement followed by periodic review and change per requirement of the business.

elements.name: Develop IT strategic alignment
elements.definition: Developing the process of aligning the organization's business divisions and staff members with the organization's planned objectives for IT.

elements.name: Articulate IT alignment principles
elements.definition: Systematic approach to clearly communicate and operate the usage of information technology as it relates to business objectives.

elements.name: Maintain IT strategic alignment
elements.definition: Maintaining alignment of the organization's business divisions and staff members with the organization's planned objectives for IT.

elements.name: Manage IT portfolio strategy
elements.definition: Strategy for systematic management of IT investments, projects, and activities. Analyze and examine the value of the IT portfolio and allocate resources based on business objectives.

elements.name: Establish and validate IT value criteria
elements.definition: Create and certify the standards to determine the value of the investments, projects, and activities of IT function for the overall business objectives.

elements.name: Determine IT portfolio investment balance
elements.definition: Determining the uninvested amount out of the total approved amount for overall IT management, IT investments, projects, and activities.

elements.name: Evaluate  proposed IT investment projects
elements.definition: Evaluating IT investment projects to achieve overall business objectives in regard to implementation, efficiency, and profitability.

elements.name: Prioritize IT projects
elements.definition: Listing the IT projects in the order of most important to the least. Determining which of many IT projects are most important or critical to business operations.

elements.name: Align IT resources to strategic priorities
elements.definition: Aligning physical IT resources like software, IT infrastructure, networks, and non-physical resources like technology expertise, to strategic objectives ranked by their importance in achieving the strategic goals.

elements.name: Align IT portfolio to business objectives
elements.definition: Aligning IT investments, projects, and activities to achieve overall business objectives.

elements.name: Define and maintain enterprise architecture
elements.definition: Outlining and maintaining the organization's IT architecture. Establish the IT architecture definition and framework. Ensure the relevance of IT. Create and confirm the approach for IT maintenance. Create rules and regulations to guide IT architecture. Authenticate and finalize all IT related research and innovation that takes place within the organization.

elements.name: Create and publish enterprise architecture principles
elements.definition: Creating and publishing high level statements of the fundamental values (principles) based on the organization's objectives that guide Information Technology decision-making and activities, and are the foundation for enterprise architecture.

elements.name: Establish and operate enterprise architecture governance
elements.definition: Establishing and operating a structure by which an enterprise defines appropriate strategies and ensures development alignment with those strategies. Create and establish the rules, regulations, policies, and standards that will govern the individual components of the IT architecture, as well as the architecture in its entirety.

elements.name: Research technologies to innovate IT services and solutions
elements.definition: Systematically investigating and studying materials and sources relevant to the IT function. Reach meaningful insights and conclusions in the form of new ideas and innovation for delivering IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Provide input to definition and prioritization of IT projects
elements.definition: Analyze the value driven through IT projects and redefine and/or reprioritize. Evaluate planning, organizing, and implementation of IT projects based on research outcomes and business objectives.

elements.name: Define IT service management strategy
elements.definition: Defining perspective, position, plans, and patterns needed to execute designing, delivering, managing, and improving the way information technology is used within an organization.

elements.name: Establish  IT service management strategy and goals
elements.definition: Implementing strategy for designing, delivering, managing, and improving the way information technology be used in the organization. The goal of IT Service Management is to ensure that the right processes, people, and technology are in place to meet business goals.

elements.name: Identify  IT service operating and process requirements
elements.definition: Identifying operating and process requirement for designing, delivering, managing, and improving the way information technology be used in the organization.

elements.name: Define IT service catalog
elements.definition: Create and design an organized and curated collection of all IT-related services that can be performed by, for, or within the organization.

elements.name: Establish IT service management framework
elements.definition: Create a layered structure for IT service management framework ensuring right processes, people, and technology are in place to meet business goals.

elements.name: Define and implement IT service management
elements.definition: Defining and implementing activities involved in designing, creating, delivering, supporting, and managing the lifecycle of information technology services within an organization.

elements.name: Define and deploy support service management process tools and methods
elements.definition: Establishing services for providing support to users of IT services and solutions. Define the plethora of services along with tools and methods by which the organization assists users of computers, software products, or other electronic/mechanical products.

elements.name: Monitor and report IT performance
elements.definition: Supervising, analyzing, and reporting performance of information technology to ensure they are on-course and on-schedule in meeting the organizational objectives and performance targets.

elements.name: Control IT management system
elements.definition: Regulating the IT management system through performance measures, governance, analysis, and monitoring through a variety of analytic tools. Evaluate IT finances, resource, services, projects, and value for report out.

elements.name: Determine IT performance measures
elements.definition: Determining measures for evaluating the performance of IT services in the organization. Establish key performance indicators, including the IT services performance index.

elements.name: Define IT control points and assurance procedures governance model
elements.definition: Establishing a governance model with its own structure and functions from where full or partial control can be exercised over the entire IT management system. Specify evaluation and quality control procedures in the structure.

elements.name: Monitor and analyze overall IT performance
elements.definition: Monitoring and analyzing information technology performance measures to ensure timely completion, and that quality assurance is met at all steps of IT services.

elements.name: Monitor and analyze IT financial performance
elements.definition: Checking and analyzing predetermined financial targets and timelines of IT management system. Monitoring their profitability, feasibility, and consistency. Study the revenues generated.

elements.name: Monitor and analyze IT value and benefits
elements.definition: Examining and analyzing the value and benefits of IT service management to ensure benefits outweigh incurred costs.

elements.name: Optimize IT resource allocation
elements.definition: Create process to assign and manage IT assets that support organization's strategic goals.

elements.name: Manage IT projects and services interdependencies
elements.definition: Manage capabilities required for the successful delivery of information technology projects, which, by extension, affect the success of the overall IT services.

elements.name: Report  IT service and project performance
elements.definition: Process of collecting, analyzing, and reporting information regarding the performance of IT services and projects.

elements.name: Select, deploy, and operate IT performance analytics tools
elements.definition: Select, establish, and operate analytics tool to analyze data and extract actionable and commercially relevant information on IT performance to evaluate or increase performance.

elements.name: Manage IT value portfolio
