elements.definition: Creating and establishing the value portfolio. Defining, analyzing, and examining the value of projects, investments, and activities of the IT function.

elements.name: Assess performance against IT service and project value criteria
elements.definition: Process of evaluating performance to collect and analyze IT services and projects. Ensure expected IT service and project value based on established criteria.

elements.name: Quantify value of IT service and project portfolio investments
elements.definition: Evaluate the value of the investments, projects, and activities of IT function by assigning it a quantifiable value with a profitable return to business operations.

elements.name: Communicate business technology value contribution
elements.definition: Conveying the value addition through adopting technology targeting towards integrated profitable business operations.

elements.name: Determine and implement IT portfolio adjustments
elements.definition: Determining and implementing IT investments, projects, and activities based on trending technological advancements in the existing environment in order to achieve overall business objectives.

elements.name: Define and manage technology innovation
elements.definition: Outline and manage the innovation of technology within the organization. Research and understand emerging future technological concepts and capabilities. Plan for IT innovation investments. Plan and execute viable innovation projects.

elements.name: Establish selection criteria for research initiatives
elements.definition: Establishing the standard for selecting IT research initiatives to align with organizational criteria for implementing future technologies.

elements.name: Analyze emerging technology concepts
elements.definition: Assessing new and future technologies relevant to the organization's vision of its IT capabilities.

elements.name: Identify technology concepts and capabilities
elements.definition: Identification of conceptual elements that define the benefits of technology to business.

elements.name: Execute IT research projects
elements.definition: Implement information technology research projects that focus on meeting the goals of the organization's IT services and capabilities.

elements.name: Evaluate IT research project outcomes
elements.definition: Assessing IT research projects based on defined outcome expectations.

elements.name: Identify and promote viable concepts
elements.definition: Determine project viability. Promote relevant IT innovations that meet business objectives.

elements.name: Develop and plan  IT investment projects
elements.definition: Develop and plan long-term allocation of funds for information technology endeavors to meet business goals.

elements.name: Develop and manage IT resilience and risk
elements.definition: Develop and include the processes required to rapidly adapt and respond to any internal or external opportunity, demand, disruption, or threat to IT. Develop a more dynamic, strategic, and integrated approach to managing risk and compliance obligations.

elements.name: Develop IT compliance, risk, and security strategy
elements.definition: Ensuring that the organization effectively manages risk. Develop rules and standards for robust IT operations, manage risk, and adopt measures to protect integrity, confidentiality, and security of IT assets.

elements.name: Determine and evaluate IT regulatory and audit requirements
elements.definition: Determining and evaluating IT regulatory and audit requirements. Train employees on regulatory and audit requirements. Records for the appropriate regulatory and audit agencies must be maintained and the new product process must be approved by the appropriate regulatory body before it is published to the organization.

elements.name: Understand business unit risk tolerance
elements.definition: Understand the risk tolerance levels of individual business units, given risk-return trade-offs for one or more anticipated and predictable consequences.

elements.name: Establish IT risk tolerance
elements.definition: Determine the specific maximum risk to take in quantitative terms for each relevant risk sub-category, including strategic, operational, financial, and compliance risks.

elements.name: Establish risk ownership
elements.definition: Establish an individual or a group who is ultimately accountable for ensuring that IT risks are managed appropriately.

elements.name: Establish and maintain risk management roles
elements.definition: Determine and maintain roles that are specialized in each risk areas and coordinating all risk management activities for IT function with due escalation structure.

elements.name: Establish compliance objectives
elements.definition: Establishing compliance objectives which ensures that the organization has systems of internal controls that adequately measure and manage IT risk.

elements.name: Identify systems to support compliance
elements.definition: Identifying and adopting information technology solutions to support changing regulatory compliance. Safeguard compliance and manage risk by outlining the risk policies and procedures.

elements.name: Identify and evaluate IT risk
elements.definition: Developing a timely and continuous process to identify and evaluate activities that might hinder IT operations or an IT project's goals.

elements.name: Evaluate  IT-related risks resiliency
elements.definition: Assess IT-related risk resilience strategies to ensure that the organization effectively manages its risk.

elements.name: Create IT risk mitigation strategies and approaches
elements.definition: Developing activities to improve performance opportunities and lessen threats in IT. Evolve strategies and policies to attain organizational objectives.

elements.name: Develop IT resilience strategy
elements.definition: Developing resilience strategies of IT across the organization so that prospective risks can be avoided.

elements.name: Determine IT delivery resiliency
elements.definition: Determining resilience strategies to ensure that IT effectively manages it's delivery process to mitigate risk.

elements.name: Determine critical IT risks
elements.definition: Determining risks that could disrupt objectives of IT.

elements.name: Prioritize IT risks
elements.definition: Prioritize potential IT risks based on business need to ensure overall IT stability.

elements.name: Establish mitigation approaches for IT risks
elements.definition: Establishing activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats for IT.

elements.name: Control IT risk, compliance, and security
elements.definition: Ensure effective control in overall IT risk management, formulate and execute guidelines in-line with regulatory bodies, and manage organizational security throughout the business operations.

elements.name: Evaluate enterprise regulatory and compliance obligations
elements.definition: Evaluation of dynamic, strategic, and integrated approach to manage regulatory requirements and compliance obligations.

elements.name: Analyze IT security threat impact
elements.definition: Analyzing the impact of threats to critical IT assets across different departments and functions in the organization in terms of quantifiable results.

elements.name: Create and maintain IT compliance requirements
elements.definition: Develop and maintain IT compliance standards. Maintaining requirements set forth by such directives as GRCP, PMI RMP, CGRC, CGEIT, CRMA.

elements.name: Create and maintain IT security policies, standards, and procedures
elements.definition: Develop and maintain an architecture for securing and ensuring the privacy of data flows throughout the organization. Create, test, evaluate, and implement IT security policies to ensure the safe use of IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Develop and deploy risk management training
elements.definition: Develop and implement training in regard to managing IT risks, understanding criticality, impact, and opportunities associated with business objectives.

elements.name: Establish risk reporting capabilities and responsibilities
elements.definition: Establishing processes to communicate IT risk to the organization.

elements.name: Establish communication standards
elements.definition: Establishing standards for communications within the organization which creates the road map for successful understanding of strategic initiatives for both business units and information technology services.

elements.name: Conduct IT risk and threat assessments
elements.definition: Evaluate IT risk and threat assessments by way of IT assets, information security, and breach points within the organization.

elements.name: Monitor and manage IT activity risk
elements.definition: Monitoring and managing risks related to IT adoption within the organization.

elements.name: Identify, supervise and monitor IT risk mitigation measures
elements.definition: Identifying and supervising a blueprint of measures for managing risk in IT. Monitor actions to enhance opportunities and reduce threats to project objectives.

elements.name: Plan and manage IT continuity
elements.definition: Planning and managing IT's ability to recover from exposure to internal and external threats.

elements.name: Evaluate IT continuity
elements.definition: Evaluating IT business needs and IT's ability to recover from internal or external threat exposure.

elements.name: Identify IT continuity gaps
elements.definition: Identifying the limitations of the IT organization's ability to remediate disruptions in IT services.

elements.name: Manage IT business continuity
elements.definition: Integrating the disciplines of Emergency Response, Crisis Management, Disaster Recovery (technology continuity) and Business Continuity for IT.

elements.name: Develop and manage IT security, privacy, and data protection
elements.definition: Creating and deploying an architecture for securing and ensuring the privacy of data flows throughout the organization. Create and develop protocols that ensure proper and efficient use of IT services and solutions

elements.name: Assess IT regulatory and confidentiality requirements and policies
elements.definition: Evaluate principles or rules employed in controlling, directing, or managing IT services. Assessing requirements and policies related to confidentiality.

elements.name: Create IT security, privacy, and data protection risk governance
elements.definition: Defining and managing organization's approach to governing IT security and ensuring the privacy of data flows throughout the organization. Establish and manage tools to support the governance process in order to avoid misuse of information and breach of organizational privacy.

elements.name: Define IT data security and privacy policies, standards, and procedures
elements.definition: Outlining and establishing policies, regulations, standards, and procedures for IT data security and privacy.

elements.name: Review and monitor physical and logical IT data security measures
elements.definition: Identifying, examining, and reviewing physical and logical IT data security measures such as hardware security (smart cards), cryptographic protocols, and access control.

elements.name: Review and monitor application security controls
elements.definition: Identifying, examining, and reviewing security control for IT applications. Test, analyze, and implement security protocols in order to safeguard IT applications.

elements.name: Review and monitor IT physical environment security controls
elements.definition: Identifying and examining security controls for physical environment of information technology such as business facilities, equipment, and resources.

elements.name: Monitor/analyze network intrusion detection data and resolve threats
elements.definition: Monitoring and evaluating network intrusion detection for any malicious activity or policy violations. Identify the gaps in order to resolve threats and enhance existing network security.

elements.name: Conduct and analyze IT compliance assessments
elements.definition: Evaluate and analyze the IT environment for the compliance of industry regulations and government legislation. Ensure that IT capability and resources meet the set standards.

elements.name: Conduct projects to enhance IT compliance and remediate risk
elements.definition: Conducting projects in order to enhance set standards, established guidelines, and risk preventive measures for IT risk and resilience.

elements.name: Conduct IT compliance control auditing of internal and external services
elements.definition: Examine compliance control systems and tools implemented for internal and external IT services.

elements.name: Perform IT compliance reporting
elements.definition: Execute IT compliance reporting in order to review processes, standards, regulations, and laws are followed as laid out by the regulatory bodies.

elements.name: Identify and escalate IT compliance issues and remediation requirements
elements.definition: Identify and escalate issues related to IT compliance to ensure that corrective measures are taken.

elements.name: Support external audits and reports
elements.definition: Supporting audits and reports through external resources. This process requires the organization to follow all the regulations set forth by external auditors.

elements.name: Develop and execute IT resilience and continuity operations
elements.definition: Create and execute a process to rapidly adapt and respond to any internal or external opportunity, demand, disruption, or threat in IT. Maintain continuous IT operations to protect employees, assets, and overall brand equity.

elements.name: Conduct IT resilience improvement projects
elements.definition: Conducting projects to improve the strategy and process for rapidly adapting to any threat in IT.

elements.name: Develop, document, and maintain IT business continuity planning
elements.definition: Develop, document, and maintain plans to ensure uninterrupted operations of critical IT services. Determine resources such as specialized personnel, equipment, support infrastructure, legal and financial aspects.

elements.name: Implement and enforce change control procedures
elements.definition: Implement and enforce procedures and policies in order to control changes in IT services and solutions. Manage changes in a rational and predictable manner for optimum resource utilization.

elements.name: Execute recurring IT service provider business continuity
elements.definition: Review and implement resources (including external parties) necessary to support uninterrupted operations of critical IT services.

elements.name: Provide  IT resilience training
elements.definition: Conduct and manage employee training programs on IT resilience so that prospective risks can be avoided.

elements.name: Execute recurring IT business operations continuity
elements.definition: Implement regular resources supporting uninterrupted operations of critical IT services.

elements.name: Manage IT user identity and authorization
elements.definition: The process of identifying, authenticating, and authorizing IT users to have access to applications, systems, IT components, or networks by associating user rights and restrictions with established identities.

elements.name: Support integration of identity and authorization policies
elements.definition: Create and implement policies that integrate authorization policies with authorized profiles of users meant to access network resources.

elements.name: Manage IT user directory
elements.definition: Managing directory of user profiles and access requirements across different levels in the organization's IT network.

elements.name: Manage IT user authorization
elements.definition: Managing the process of authorizing IT users to access applications, systems, IT components, or networks by associating user rights.

elements.name: Manage IT user authentication mechanisms
elements.definition: Create and manage the process to authenticate IT users from user directory based on the internal policies.

elements.name: Audit IT user identity and authorization systems
elements.definition: Examine the processes responsible for reviewing IT user identity and authorization.

elements.name: Respond to IT information security and network breaches
elements.definition: Address any form of unauthorized network breach such as unauthorized access or usage of data, applications, services, networks, and/or devices. Identify the root cause and take corrective measures to resolve the breach.

elements.name: Conduct penetration testing
elements.definition: Conduct penetration testing (pen test) through an authorized stimulated attack to identify security weakness in an IT environment by evaluating the system or network with various harmful techniques.

elements.name: Audit integration of user identity and authorization systems
elements.definition: Reviewing the processes responsible for integration of user identity and access authorization in order to confirm that all the required regulations are followed.

elements.name: Manage information
elements.definition: Creating strategies to manage the organization's information and content. Outline the architecture for information. Administer information resources. Administer the management of data and content.

elements.name: Define business information and analytics strategy
elements.definition: Create an organization-wide strategy for the IT function by combining skills, technologies, applications, and processes in order to attain organizations objectives.

elements.name: Establish data, information, and analytic objectives
elements.definition: Implementing strategies for securing and ensuring the privacy of data flows throughout the organization. Create protocols and guidelines for individual IT components. Outline analytic objectives in order to avoid misuse of information.

elements.name: Establish data, information, and analytic governance
elements.definition: Creating a set of guidelines that ensure effective and efficient use of IT. Define data, information, and analytic governance to reach the organization's goal.

elements.name: Access IT data/analytic capabilities
elements.definition: Determining the request for data accessibility and analysis. Review the details based on internal data security policies and permit data access only if internal policies and data access parameters are met.

elements.name: Define and maintain business information architecture
elements.definition: Creating strategies to manage the organization's information and content. Outline the architecture for information collection and communication. Administer information resources, data management and content.

elements.name: Determine enterprise business information requirements
elements.definition: Determining strategies to manage the enterprise wide flow of business information and content. Outline the required architecture for information resources.

elements.name: Define enterprise data models
elements.definition: Define different ways of representation, usage, and identification of data with independent or interdependent sources across the organization.

elements.name: Identify and understand external data sources
elements.definition: Identifying and understanding external sources of data in relevance of reliability, security, and authenticity.

elements.name: Establish  data ownership and stewardship responsibilities
elements.definition: Establishing entities responsible for data accuracy, integrity, and timeliness that can authorize or deny access to certain data. Develop data utilizing governance processes to ensure fitness of data elements.

elements.name: Maintain and evolve enterprise data and information architecture
elements.definition: Creating and maintaining the process of designing, creating, deploying, and managing strategies to maintain enterprise data and information architecture.

elements.name: Define and execute business information lifecycle planning and control
elements.definition: Develop and implement strategies to plan and manage the flow of an information system's data from creation and initial storage to the time when it becomes obsolete and deleted.

elements.name: Define and maintain enterprise information policies, standards, and procedures
elements.definition: Outlining and establishing policies for information and setting information standards and procedures. Establish policies to regulate the creation, use, storage, access, communication, and dissemination of information.

elements.name: Implement and execute data administration responsibilities
elements.definition: Implementing and executing strategies for processes and technologies that support the collection, managing, and storing of data.

elements.name: Manage business information content
elements.definition: Creating strategies to administer information and content. Understand the needs of the organization for information and content management. Realize the role of IT services for implementing the overall business strategy. Assess the implications of new technologies for managing information and content. Identify and prioritize the most effective and efficient actions for managing information and content.

elements.name: Monitor and control business information
elements.definition: Defining the rules, diction, and logic that make up the framework of the organization's information architecture. Monitoring and controlling information attributes that flow through the IT framework.

elements.name: Maintain business information feeds and repositories
elements.definition: Maintain information feedstock along with IT hardware and software needed for storage, access, and retrieval of business information.

elements.name: Perform internal usage audits
elements.definition: Verification of information access and usage through regular reports on organizational performance.

elements.name: Implement and administer business information access
elements.definition: Implement and manage the process for accessing information including issues related to copyright, open source, privacy, and security.

elements.name: Develop and manage services/solutions
elements.definition: Designing and maintaining the IT services/solutions catalogue. Evaluate the performance of IT services/solutions. Communicate the results to the management.

elements.name: Develop service/solution and integration strategy
elements.definition: Developing service/solution along with creating a strategy that provides a base for delivering service/solution aligned with overall business needs. Conduct research within the services/solutions field for development and integration.

elements.name: Determine IT service/solution development
elements.definition: Determining the development of IT service/solution. Analyze the pros and cons of IT service/solution and it's methods on the basis of their cost effectiveness and development value.

elements.name: Define IT service/solution development processes/standards
elements.definition: Establishing the methods and processes as the foundation for developing new IT platforms, components, software, and explore new standards for better IT usage in the organization.

elements.name: Identify, deploy, and support development methodologies and tools
elements.definition: Identifying and implementing techniques and tools for development based on overall value addition to the IT environment.

elements.name: Establish service component criteria
elements.definition: Establishing standards for selection of IT service components.

elements.name: Understand and select reusable service components
elements.definition: Understanding and selecting reusable service components so that they can be cost-effective and efficient.

elements.name: Maintain service component portfolio
elements.definition: Creating and establishing service component portfolio by defining investments, and activities. Analyze and examine the value of the service component portfolio, and allocate resources towards it.

elements.name: Establish development standards exception governance
elements.definition: Creating standards and procedures for developing IT services/solutions outside of defined business parameters.

elements.name: Manage service/solution lifecycle planning
elements.definition: Executing life-cycle planning for IT services and solutions. Develop new requirements and feature-function enhancements. Create and design a life cycle plan that addresses the current and future state of IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Monitor and track emerging technology capabilities
elements.definition: Perform a systematic investigation to new and future technology capabilities for future upgrades.

elements.name: Identify IT services/solutions
elements.definition: Identifying processes and supporting procedures that are performed by an organization to design, plan, deliver, operate, and control information technology services/solutions offered to customers.

elements.name: Determine IT service/solution approach
elements.definition: Determining an approach to create a base for delivering IT service/solution aligned with overall business needs while maintaining a tight control on delivery and costs.

elements.name: Define IT solution lifecycle
elements.definition: Defining solutions to satisfy business needs. IT solution lifecycle provides a means to address the full life cycle of an information technology solution and addresses the current and future state of IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Develop IT service/solution "sunset" plans
elements.definition: Developing plans to retire IT service/solution resources when the service/solution is no longer feasible.

elements.name: Develop and manage service/solution architecture
elements.definition: Creating the architecture for the IT services and solutions. Assess architecture and business constraints in order to understand integration requirements. Promote existing architecture. Manage exceptions.

elements.name: Assess IT application and infrastructure architecture constraints
elements.definition: Assessing limitations in IT application and infrastructure architecture that may hinder expected performance.

elements.name: Assess business constraints on IT service/solution
elements.definition: Evaluate business limitations that may hinder IT service/solution performance.

elements.name: Determine IT component integration requirements
elements.definition: Determining the requirements to integrate IT components such as hardware, software, database, telecommunication, and network.

elements.name: Identify opportunities for IT component reuse
elements.definition: Identification of opportunities for reusing IT components so that they can be cost-effective and efficient.

elements.name: Promote adoption of existing service/solution architecture
elements.definition: Encouraging acceptance of existing IT service/solution architecture in the organization.

elements.name: Develop and maintain service/solution architectures
elements.definition: Creating and maintaining a services and solutions architecture over a network that can be revised as needed or even eliminated in case of inefficiencies.

elements.name: Assess IT service/solution architecture conformance
elements.definition: Assessing functional compliance of the IT service/solution architecture. Safeguard compliance with guidelines for the architecture.

elements.name: Manage architectural exceptions
elements.definition: Identifying and resolving any architectural exceptions. Address the internal inquiries related to architecture that cannot be addressed immediately. Research inquiries that require the need of exceptional methods.

elements.name: Execute IT service/solution creation and testing
elements.definition: Understanding customer requirements. Design the IT services and solutions based on the requirements. Develop components for providing the requirements. Train resources to provide support. Test the IT services and solutions in advance. Confirm the customer experience post-sale.

elements.name: Execute IT service/solution development lifecycle
elements.definition: Executing an information system, aiming to produce a high quality system that meets or exceeds customer expectations, reaches completion within time and cost estimates, and is inexpensive to maintain and cost-effective to enhance.

elements.name: Assess and validate IT service/solution requirements
elements.definition: Evaluating and validating the requirements and needs of IT service/solution.

elements.name: Create service/solution design
elements.definition: Formulating a design for service/solution that helps an organization to meet its objectives. Develop a new framework for molding the service/solution processes into a coherent and structured form.

elements.name: Build and test IT service/solution components
elements.definition: Building and testing new components required for the development of IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Integrate IT components and services
elements.definition: Combining the newly built IT component along with IT services in order to gain optimum output.

elements.name: Execute IT service/solution validation
elements.definition: Validating that the proposed IT service/solution is feasible and provides the needed services for the customer.

elements.name: Bundle service/solution deployment packaging
elements.definition: Creating and implementing a strategy for the deployment of IT service/solution by defining all of the activities that make the IT function available for use. Define the deployment process, procedures, and tools. Select the most feasible and practical methodologies for the deployment process.

elements.name: Manage service/solution process exceptions
elements.definition: Identifying and resolving internal needs/inquiries for service/solution that cannot be resolved immediately. Research inquiries that require the need of exceptional solutions.

elements.name: Perform service/solution maintenance and testing
elements.definition: Engaging in all aspects of service/solution maintenance and testing includes all preventative, routine, and corrective activates. Ensure that IT service/solution are functioning properly and regulations where applicable.

elements.name: Execute IT service/solution maintenance lifecycle
elements.definition: Executing IT service/solution maintenance lifecycle in order to reduce maintenance costs and increase reliability of IT infrastructure concerning service/solution related problems.

elements.name: Assess IT remediation
elements.definition: Evaluate plans to address information technology environmental adulteration for rectification efforts.

elements.name: Modify service/solution design
elements.definition: Redesign the roadmap to seek solution or service with an overall process flow and impact timeframe.

elements.name: Perform IT service/solution remediation
elements.definition: Administering the efforts and activities for IT service/solution remediation. This process element requires the organization to create plans for corrective action in collaboration with government agencies and pertinent professional services agencies which specialize in remediation efforts relevant to the organization's service/solution. Additionally, the organization needs to consult experts to validate the plan, determine resources allocation, resolve any legal concerns, and formulate a company-wide policy for IT service/solution remediation.

elements.name: Manage service/solution operations
elements.definition: Understanding customer requirements. Managing services/solutions based on the requirements. Develop components for providing the requirements. Train resources to provide support. Confirm the customer experience post-sale. Evaluate the performance of service/solution. Communicate the results to the management.

elements.name: Prepare fixed/enhanced service/solution packaging
elements.definition: Developing packaging for fixed/enhanced service/solution based on the standalone or bundled offerings to be used by the organization.

elements.name: Deploy services/solutions
elements.definition: Executing IT services/solutions by creating a strategy for deployment. Plan and execute the changes. Plan and administer the release of its IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Develop and manage service/solution deployment strategy
elements.definition: Creating and implementing a strategy for the deployment of IT service/solution. Define all of the activities that make the IT function available for use. Establish the change policies for IT services and solutions. Define the deployment process, procedures, and tools. Select the most feasible and practical methodologies for the deployment process.

elements.name: Assess IT deployment business impact
elements.definition: Evaluate the impact of IT deployment (products/services) on the business. Compare pre and post development performance, behavior of resources, and cost to assess organizational benefit.

elements.name: Establish IT deployment policies
elements.definition: Defining deployment policies regarding IT services and solutions to allow employees to plan accordingly. Reduce the negative impact to the user community.

elements.name: Define and create deployment procedure workflow
elements.definition: Outlining processes, methods, and equipment for deployment of IT solutions. Manage core operations servers like subversion server, production server, and development server, to make the IT services and solutions available for internal/client use.

elements.name: Define IT change/release standards
elements.definition: Establishing guidelines for the changed/released IT services and solutions to meet business objectives with optimum utilization.

elements.name: Assign deployment approval responsibilities
elements.definition: Coordinating development approval responsibilities based on defined change standards.

elements.name: Analyze deployments outcomes
elements.definition: Evaluating the impact (pros and cons) of IT services deployment.

elements.name: Plan service and solution implementation
elements.definition: Strategizing and executing changes in IT solutions and services. Create a plan for deploying the changes. Communicate with stakeholders about the changes. Administer and implement the changes. Train the resources who will be affected by these changes. Install changes and verify their effect.

elements.name: Assess IT deployment risk
elements.definition: Accessing threats and potential failures related to the deployment of IT services/solutions.

elements.name: Define implementation schedule and roll-out sequence
elements.definition: Defining the schedule for implementation of change. Plan and carry out a process or procedure to implement the predefined changes.

elements.name: Determine implementation requirements
elements.definition: Determine requirements for implementation of IT deployment. Carry out a pre-implementation audit to assess the impact and use case. Gauge the possible vulnerabilities and impact the business operations during and after the implementation.

elements.name: Plan and align user testing and resources
elements.definition: Plan methodologies and align resources for user testing of IT deployment.

elements.name: Develop IT training
elements.definition: Create and manage employee training programs by considering the need and availability of these programs. Manage all aspects related to the training programs.

elements.name: Create implementation communications
elements.definition: Coordinating change implementation in IT services and solutions communications with employees and stakeholders.

elements.name: Manage IT roll-back procedures
elements.definition: Managing procedures to return to initial pre-deployment stage or previous state from current environment.

elements.name: Manage change deployment control
elements.definition: Creating and deploying an architecture for securing the changes deployed in the organization. Create and develop protocols that ensure proper and efficient use of deployed IT services and solutions. Test, evaluate, and implement the policies and protocols.

elements.name: Asses IT change/release impact
elements.definition: Evaluating the impact of IT change/release on the business.

elements.name: Confirm change/release compliance
elements.definition: Ensure that change/release meets change guidelines set by the organization.

elements.name: Assess IT change/release risk
elements.definition: Evaluating for any kind of risks or threats which could be caused due to IT change/release deployment.

elements.name: Consolidate IT change
elements.definition: Integrate all forms of changes in IT in order to make more efficient use of resources and down time, and optimizing results.

elements.name: Create and communicate deployment schedule
elements.definition: Defining and communicating the schedule for implementation to related stakeholders and functions.

elements.name: Approve change/release deployment
elements.definition: Permitting for the change/release deployment. Approve deployment based on the evaluation of business impact due to change/release.

elements.name: Document IT change/release outcome
elements.definition: Recording outcomes related to the change/release deployment.

elements.name: Implement technology solutions
elements.definition: Deploy the identified solutions for information technology important for healthy business operations. Confirm status and operational availability of IT resources. Perform testing and distribution of change. Execute roll-back protocol if necessary.

elements.name: Confirm hardware/software operational status
elements.definition: Confirm if hardware/software are operating as per the expectation.

elements.name: Confirm operational availability
elements.definition: Confirm if operational activities of IT services could be performed.

elements.name: Execute internal IT implementation plan
elements.definition: Executing IT implementation plan to make the IT services and solutions available for internal use.

elements.name: Confirm implementation completion
elements.definition: Confirming the completion of IT implementation.

elements.name: Implement software change/release
elements.definition: Executing changes in software and services as per change/release schedule.

elements.name: Perform post-installation testing
elements.definition: Perform testing after installation to confirm expected performance is met.

elements.name: Distribute software components network-wide
elements.definition: Distributing and implementing the release of changed IT solutions. Administer, implement, and install the releases onto internal systems. Provide methods for installing releases on client users.

elements.name: Verify change/release implementation success
elements.definition: Confirming that the release has met expectations.

elements.name: Execute roll-back plan
elements.definition: Execution of plan to return to the previous operating state if the change/release impedes operational expectations.

elements.name: Perform service and solution rollout
elements.definition: Strategizing and executing changes in IT solutions and services. Create a plan for deploying the changes. Communicate with stakeholders about the changes. Administer and implement the changes. Train the resources who will be affected by these changes. Install changes and verify their effect.

elements.name: Conduct IT training
elements.definition: Preparing users for changes in IT solutions. Conduct training sessions and engagement activities to familiarize users with the new changes. Implementing the programs for training IT employees.

elements.name: Prepare and distribute service/solution communications
elements.definition: Coordinating communications regarding the changes in IT services and solutions with employees in the organization.

elements.name: Support organizational changes
elements.definition: Creating a strategy for providing support for organizational changes. Providing support to users of IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Execute rollout plans
elements.definition: Executing a plan for introducing the IT services and solutions to the organization's end user base.

elements.name: Provide rollout support
elements.definition: Establishing services for providing support to users of IT services and solutions for rollout. Define the plethora of services by which the organization assists users of technology products.

elements.name: Manage rollout support capabilities
elements.definition: Managing the necessary skills and competencies required to efficiently provide IT resolution for rollout through the support structure. Identify the gaps and needs in support structure.

elements.name: Monitor and record rollout issues
elements.definition: Track and record any issues being faced due to rollout. Define methodology of assessment for measuring and monitoring issues.

elements.name: Create and manage support services/solutions
elements.definition: Establishing and managing services for providing support to users of IT services and solutions. Define the plethora of services by which the organization assists users of computers, software products, or other information technology products.

elements.name: Define and establish service delivery strategy
elements.definition: Defining and establishing strategy for delivering IT services and solutions to the users. Design an IT service delivery model that defines the processes and procedures needed to deliver the IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Assess business objectives and IT service delivery
elements.definition: Assessing the goals and objectives of IT service delivery and how it contributes to the overall business objectives. Align with the business objectives of the organization.

elements.name: Define IT service delivery portfolio
elements.definition: Creating and establishing a repository of IT service delivery offerings.

elements.name: Create and maintain IT service delivery model
elements.definition: Design and maintaining an IT service delivery model that defines the processes and procedures needed to deliver the IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Determine IT service delivery locations and activities
elements.definition: Determining locations and types of IT services and solutions which need to be delivered.

elements.name: Define IT service delivery sourcing strategy
elements.definition: Defining a strategy for sourcing delivery of IT services and solutions. Examine the pros and cons of various sources that can support the delivery process. Select the most feasible and cost-effective sources.

elements.name: Define and develop service support strategy
elements.definition: Defining and creating a strategy for provision of support to users of IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Assess business objectives and IT service support delivery
elements.definition: Assessing the goals of IT service support delivery and how it aligns to contribute to the overall business objectives.

elements.name: Define IT service support portfolio
elements.definition: Defining different IT support services and solutions such as remote support and cloud support. Include planned IT initiatives and ongoing IT services (such as application support).

elements.name: Create and maintain IT support model
elements.definition: Design and maintaining an IT support model that defines the processes and procedures needed to support users of IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Develop IT support service sourcing strategy
elements.definition: Developing a strategy for sourcing resources to support users of IT services and solutions. Establish sources that will make use of e-mail, live support software online, or a tool where users can log a call or incident in order to retrieve IT support.

elements.name: Establish support service framework
elements.definition: Creating an agenda for the rules and regulations of support service that deal with providing support to users of IT services and solutions.

elements.name: Provide service support tools and technology
elements.definition: Providing the tools and techniques to support users of IT services and solutions, and choosing the most appropriate tools and techniques. Evaluate the pros and cons of all the methodologies and tools available. Choose the most efficient and effective methodology.

elements.name: Plan and manage service delivery control
elements.definition: Determine and manage service delivery flow across different business functions. Understand the level of services needed by different stakeholders. Identify major service delivery touch points and criticality associated. Ensure timely communication with users.

elements.name: Plan operational activities for IT service delivery
elements.definition: Planning different delivery services for operational activities within the IT function. Use service delivery systems to manage the IT service delivery services.

elements.name: Schedule service delivery resources
elements.definition: Scheduling resources to provide service delivery to IT users. Ensure design, development, deployment, and operations are aligned with the business objectives.

elements.name: Maintain/optimize batch job schedule
elements.definition: Maintaining and scheduling batch jobs to run in the background at a certain date and time.

elements.name: Schedule change/release windows
elements.definition: Determine the timely change or release of IT services or support. Assign periodic release/change to IT systems or services.

elements.name: Schedule/optimize backup and archive activities
elements.definition: Schedule or optimize backup and archive activities for IT services and solutions. Use a backup system or application and archive operations data for future retrieval.

elements.name: Balance operational workloads across available infrastructure components
elements.definition: Balancing workloads of all the processes and services that are provisioned to their internal or external clients, across available components of IT infrastructure. No component should be over or under utilized with the workflow of the IT operations.

elements.name: Determine specific problem support procedures
elements.definition: Determining process and procedure to provide support for specific IT service problems.

elements.name: Develop and manage infrastructure resource planning
elements.definition: Developing and managing the resources required for administration of infrastructure. Manage the IT inventory and assets to meet organization's IT resource capacity.

elements.name: Develop IT service delivery strategy
elements.definition: Creating a strategy for delivering IT services and solutions. Establish the sourcing strategy. Establish the delivery process procedures and tools. Examine and choose the most effective methodologies and tools.

elements.name: Assess IT infrastructure business objectives
elements.definition: Assessing the goals and objectives of IT infrastructure and how it contributes to the overall business objectives.

elements.name: Determine ongoing IT infrastructure capabilities
elements.definition: Determining existing IT infrastructure capabilities. Identify the gaps and needs in order to enhance the existing IT infrastructure to meet growth objectives.

elements.name: Plan IT infrastructure change
elements.definition: Identify the gaps and needs of existing IT infrastructure. Plan and develop strategies to upgrade/replace existing IT infrastructure.

elements.name: Plan and budget IT license usage volumes
elements.definition: Creating a plan associated with usage volumes of IT licenses. Develop a framework to govern the licensing of an IT services along with identified usage volumes. Determine the amount of investment in IT license usage volumes and how would the license volumes be financed.

elements.name: Define service support planning
elements.definition: Develop strategies and methodologies to provide service support. Examine service levels, support complexity, stakeholder requirements to offer service support.

elements.name: Understand IT support demand patterns
elements.definition: Evaluate criticality catered by the IT support and expectations to resolve raised or identified issues. Determine the usual requests received for IT support for each area of IT operations. Ensure resolution to every identified or reported issue within specified SLAs.

elements.name: Determine required support resource levels, responsibilities, and capabilities
elements.definition: Determining levels of required support resources along with their responsibilities, and capabilities to resolve IT issues. Evaluate and ensure that support resources are fulfilling their responsibilities n a timely manner.

elements.name: Maintain service support knowledge repository
elements.definition: Create and maintain service support knowledge repository. Store, maintain, access, revise, and use knowledge for IT services. Review knowledge trends and implement knowledge transfer methodologies for competitive advantage.

elements.name: Maintain service support learning
elements.definition: Maintaining and transfer of knowledge towards service support with the change/upgrade in technology over a stipulated period. Ensure IT staff is well trained and tested on the new learning of service support.

elements.name: Communicate service support needs
elements.definition: Conveying service support needs within the organization, with the objective of providing required support services. Define processes and procedures needed to support users of IT services and solutions. Convey these procedures to appropriate governing authority.

elements.name: Define IT escalation mechanisms
elements.definition: Determining mechanisms to report for a higher degree of decision making depending on the criticality of IT escalations. Define the processes and procedures needed to follow for IT escalation at different levels. Convey the mechanisms within the organization.

elements.name: Manage IT service support resources
elements.definition: Managing resources required for administration of IT service support. Establish sources that will make use of e-mail, live support software online, or a tool where users can log a call or incident in order to retrieve IT support.

elements.name: Coordinate with external support providers
elements.definition: Developing a strategy that will make use of multiple resources to coordinate with external support providers in order to make the support services work more smoother.

elements.name: Triage IT service delivery incidents
elements.definition: Sorting the incidents of IT service delivery in certain order so that the services could be delivered based on the criticality.

elements.name: Monitor IT service support performance
elements.definition: Defining methodology and frequency of assessment for measuring and monitoring performance of various processes and activities of IT service support against standard set goals.

elements.name: Develop and manage service delivery operations
elements.definition: Developing and managing different delivery services using service delivery systems for operational activities within the IT function in order to achieve organizations goal.

elements.name: Operate and monitor online systems
elements.definition: Operating and defining methodology of assessment for measuring and monitoring performance of online systems against its expected result.

elements.name: Run and monitor batch job schedule
elements.definition: Operate and monitor the application of scheduling batch jobs to be run in the background at a certain date and time.

elements.name: Manage service delivery workloads
elements.definition: Analyze and manage workload needs in relation to service delivery. Plan resources and mechanism around those workload needs so that services could be delivered smoothly.

elements.name: Manage infrastructure performance and capacity
elements.definition: Managing the performance and capacity of infrastructure by using key performance indicators to routinely track the performance and capacity levels. Review performance. Evaluate the efficiency and effectiveness of the infrastructure.

elements.name: Respond to unplanned operational issues
elements.definition: Addressing to an issue in operational activities within the IT function, that occur outside of normal routine or preventative maintenance.

elements.name: Produce and distribute output media
elements.definition: Identify and introduce resources to display output in a viewable form to key decision makers and evaluators.

elements.name: Monitor IT infrastructure security
elements.definition: Identifying, examining, and recognizing any flaw or breach in security of IT infrastructure. Ensure that protocols and guidelines for individual IT components are being followed and there is no misuse of information and breach of individual or organizational privacy.

elements.name: Manage IT infrastructure/data recovery
elements.definition: Managing resources of IT infrastructure and their recovery capacity. Manage storage, computer hardware, software, and infrastructure resources that can be stored as inventory or provided by the organization as needed. Managing backup/recovery for IT services and solutions. Use a backup system or application.

elements.name: Manage infrastructure resource administration
elements.definition: Managing the resources required for administration of IT infrastructure. Manage the IT inventory and assets. Take care of the organization's IT resource capacity.

elements.name: Manage infrastructure configuration
elements.definition: Identifying and tracking individual configuration items, documenting functional capabilities and interdependencies of IT infrastructure. Determining the gaps and needs in order to enhance existing infrastructure configuration.

elements.name: Perform infrastructure component maintenance
elements.definition: Evaluating and maintaining all aspects of infrastructure component maintenance. Ensure that all components of an IT infrastructure are functioning properly as per the expectation. Maintenance includes all preventative, routine, and corrective measures.

elements.name: Install/configure/upgrade infrastructure components
elements.definition: Installing/configuring/upgrading all the components required for operational activities within IT infrastructure. Ensure that all components of an IT infrastructure are functioning properly and updated to latest version/technology.

elements.name: Maintain IT asset records
elements.definition: Maintaining the complete list of IT items or resources available with the organization with the details on date of purchase, licenses, deployment and SLAs.

elements.name: Administer IT licenses/user agreements
elements.definition: Administering and overseeing the terms and policies associated with licensing the IT intellectual property. Create and manage the policies and terms governing the possible granting of a license to any external agent. Demarcate a clear framework that governs the licensing of any patents or copyrights held by the organization.

elements.name: Provide IT infrastructure service and capabilities
elements.definition: Providing all the infrastructure services and capabilities required for operational activities within the IT function supporting overall business objectives.

elements.name: Operate IT user support
elements.definition: Managing systematic user support functionality and capability through defined procedures. Determine, record, and monitor user requests. Execute issue/request resolution. Utilize escalation path when needed. Resolve issue/request.

elements.name: Triage IT issues/requests
elements.definition: Evaluate and assign IT issues/requests accordingly to allow for the correct routing of IT issues to the relevant support teams.

elements.name: Provide IT resolution capabilities
elements.definition: Providing the necessary skills and competencies required to efficiently provide IT resolution through the support structure.

elements.name: Manage IT user requests
elements.definition: Creating an effective plan and structure to address and resolve requests of IT users. Determine, record, and monitor user requests. Obtain information about the effectiveness and performance of the user request handling process from the IT users through various means.

elements.name: Escalate IT requests
elements.definition: Follow processes and procedures to escalate IT requests to required levels for resolution or effective decision making when necessary.

elements.name: Resolve IT issues/requests
elements.definition: Creating a structure to resolve issues/requests of IT services using different mechanisms.

elements.name: Execute IT continuity and recovery action
elements.definition: Successfully implement preventive measures to manage IT risk of exposure to internal and external threats. Integrating the disciplines of Emergency Response, Crisis Management, Disaster Recovery (technology continuity) and Business Continuity for IT.

elements.name: Manage Financial Resources
elements.definition: Overseeing key back-office processes for organizations. This category includes process groups related to planning and management accounting, revenue accounting, general accounting and reporting, fixed-asset project accounting, payroll, accounts payable and expense reimbursements, treasury operations, internal controls, tax management, international funds/consolidation, and global trade services.

elements.name: Perform planning and management accounting
elements.definition: Determining different stages of the planning process and accounting. Classify, determine, analyze, interpret, and communicate information to make up-to-date business decisions for better management and control functions.

elements.name: Perform planning/budgeting/forecasting
elements.definition: Allocating funds to meet future and current financial goals. Led by the chief financial officer, have the finance function plan, budget, and forecast in order to determine and describe long and short-term financial goals.

elements.name: Develop and maintain budget policies and procedures
elements.definition: Formulating financial budgetary guidelines and strategies. Develop a framework for rules and regulations regarding budgets. Create a step-by-step process to achieve financial goals.

elements.name: Prepare periodic budgets and plans
elements.definition: Creating reports on a quarterly or annual basis for fund allocation. Create a financial statement that estimates revenues and expenses over a specific period of time. (Leverage budget methods such as cost-based and zero-based budgeting techniques, in light of the periodic targets outlined during Develop and maintain budget policies and procedures [10771].)

elements.name: Operationalize and implement plans to achieve budget
elements.definition: Putting budgeting plans into practical use keeping within designated forecasting parameters.

elements.name: Prepare periodic financial forecasts
elements.definition: Creating estimates of the projected income and expenses required over a predetermined time frame. Develop the projections of profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and the cash flow forecast.

elements.name: Perform variance analysis against forecasts and budgets
elements.definition: Conducting a quantitative analysis between what was forecasted and budgeted and actual financial behavior.

elements.name: Perform cost accounting and control
elements.definition: Defining costs to be incurred and methods for optimum utilization. Determine the costs of products, processes, projects, etc. to compile in the financial statements, as well as to assist management in making decisions regarding planning and control. Control costs by managing and reducing business expenses.

elements.name: Perform inventory accounting
elements.definition: Conducting accounting for assets, and finding reasons for changes (depreciation, obsolescence, deterioration, change in customer taste, increased demand, decreased market supply, etc.).

elements.name: Perform profit center accounting
elements.definition: Determining the revenue, profits, and losses incurred by each unit within the organization that produces profit.

elements.name: Perform cost of patient referral analysis
elements.definition: Studying expenses directly associated with product. Analyze the cost of sales, which is the cost of manufacturing products.

elements.name: Perform service costing
elements.definition: Studying and finding out the relevant cost center for a product by studying every resource used in its making.

elements.name: Perform variance analysis
elements.definition: Discovering the changes between forecasted and actual costing. Analyze actual and planned behavior by reviewing the amount of a variance on a trend line in order to maintain control over a business.

elements.name: Report on profitability
elements.definition: Making a report about revenues generated by the organization or business unit concerned. This process requires the organization to create a report which shows how business is generating profits. Profits are the part which is left after paying all expenses directly related to the generation of the revenue, such as producing a product, and other expenses related to conducting business activities.

elements.name: Perform cost management
elements.definition: Deciding which expenses can be avoided to reduce some costs and increase revenues. Plan and control the organization's budget to forecast future expenditures.

elements.name: Determine key cost drivers
elements.definition: Defining cost drivers for a particular activity.

elements.name: Measure cost drivers
elements.definition: Calculating cost drivers.

elements.name: Determine critical activities
elements.definition: Determine the activities that hinder the progress of finance activities. This requires the organization to determine those business activities carried out by the financial function of the organization and which are indispensable. This undertaking helps the organization triangulate those activities which are essential and where costs cannot be slashed.

elements.name: Manage asset resource deployment and utilization
elements.definition: Distributing or allocating asset resources in different processes for optimal utilization.

elements.name: Evaluate and manage financial performance
elements.definition: Checking and achieving predetermined financial targets and timelines. Assess and manage the profitability, feasibility, and consistency of a business or project. Study the revenues generated.

elements.name: Assess patient and service profitability
elements.definition: Studying product demand and targeted customer preferences. Study customers' demands or preferences after deducting the cost of delivering the final product.

elements.name: Evaluate new services
elements.definition: Checking demand about a specific product by a customer segment. Conduct a detailed study--or research a customer behavior or preference for a product--in order to determine its production and profitability in a specific market.

elements.name: Perform life cycle costing
elements.definition: Determining the cost of delivering an end product at different stages of production. Study the total life cycle of a product/process to determine how much revenue and production cost will be incurred at every stage in order to make strategic decisions.

elements.name: Optimize payor and service mix
elements.definition: Creating the best fit between a product and the end user. Maximize the customer base by providing different products in the market.

elements.name: Track performance of new- patient and service strategies
elements.definition: Observing the behavior of a new set of customers for different products. Prepare strategies to improve sales and profits.

elements.name: Prepare activity-based performance measures
elements.definition: Evaluating performance based on different sets of activities created by management to measure performance.

elements.name: Manage continuous cost improvement
elements.definition: Conducting activities to improve cost distribution regularly. Follow or adopt different ways of reducing costs.

elements.name: Perform revenue accounting
elements.definition: Comparing revenue targets to reality. Review all transactions and entries passed in final accounts in a year in order to examine profits.

elements.name: Process customer credit
elements.definition: Evaluating and processing requests for advances. Evaluate credit requests by customers requiring loans to buy products/services.

elements.name: Establish credit policies
elements.definition: Creating guidelines for providing advances. Set up credit standards, credit terms, and collection policies.

elements.name: Analyze/Approve new account applications
elements.definition: Checking and accepting new requests based on eligibility criteria. Analyze the status of applicants and requirements to be met for a new account.

elements.name: Analyze credit scoring history
elements.definition: Reviewing past credit scores to determine the if a line of credit will be extended to potential customers. This could also include extending additional credit to existing accounts.

elements.name: Forecast credit scoring requirement
elements.definition: Planning credit score requirements based on established credit policies.

elements.name: Review existing accounts
elements.definition: Evaluating existing account holders and their past performance. Regularly review existing accounts to get the required information about the status at present.

elements.name: Produce credit/collection reports
elements.definition: Preparing account payable reports about payments to be made according to accounting rules and principles, and providing the reports to management.

elements.name: Reinstate or suspend accounts based on credit policies
elements.definition: Closing or restarting accounts according to changes made in credit policies.

elements.name: Invoice the payor(s)
elements.definition: Preparing detailed reports of customer purchases. Prepare a commercial document between the seller and customer with details about transaction. Detail the quantity purchased, price of products/services, date, parties involved, unique invoice number, and tax information.

elements.name: Maintain patient master files
elements.definition: Creating and updating a record of customers and the products being purchased by them in a database. This process element requires the organization to maintain a database of customers and their purchases. Such a master-file can be used to ensure customer touch point, enhance customer satisfaction, explore cross selling opportunities, and identify future trends. This database will include several particulars about the personal details of the organization's customers and a tracking of the products being sold.

elements.name: Capture charges
elements.definition: Capturing each episode of care, charges for services, and materials used in a system or manual logged for billing of each episode (i.e., visit or encounter).

elements.name: Code the Patient's Account
elements.definition: Conducting concurrent coding with the episode of care, and code a patient's account after the patient is finished with the encounter and during the bill hold. Coding is where certified healthcare coders review medical documentation and apply the appropriate diagnosis, procedures and discharge codes for billing purposes.

elements.name: Prepare bill for the payor
elements.definition: Preparing a bill by checking all appropriate documentation is collected and included in the bill for efficient adjudication.  Format the bill to the appropriate format for the respective payors.

elements.name: Rectify any billing edits
elements.definition: Correcting errors or gaps in the bill documentation that may from a back office system or some clearinghouses

elements.name: Transmit the bill to the payor
elements.definition: Providing information to customers about purchases made by them. Communicate the details of purchases. Provide customers with a copy of details for their reference.

elements.name: Resolve payor billing inquiries
elements.definition: Checking and solving billing queries raised by customers.

elements.name: Process accounts receivable (AR)
elements.definition: Processing payments due from customers. This includes all processing of funds received, whether by check or electronically. This does not include the generation of invoices.

elements.name: Establish AR policies
elements.definition: Creating rules and regulations to be followed in case of credit sales to customers. Create rules and procedures to follow at the time of sale (e.g., the allowable number of installments).

elements.name: Receive/Deposit customer payments
elements.definition: Collecting cash from customers. Deposit it into bank account. Make entries into the books of accounts.

elements.name: Apply cash remittances
elements.definition: Checking and moving funds between countries for business activities, typically through authorized remittance agents.

elements.name: Prepare AR reports
elements.definition: Preparing reports that detail balances due or what to collect from customers at a certain point in time.

elements.name: Post AR activity to the general ledger
elements.definition: Preparing the general ledger for account receivables from journals. Place all journal entries related to accounts receivables in the general ledger accounts of a business.

elements.name: Manage and process collections
elements.definition: Posting entries to respective accounts, and preparing accounts for receivables. Manage the cash collected by the business from its debtors. Record it in the books of accounts to provide clear information about the availability of the cash.

elements.name: Establish policies for delinquent accounts
elements.definition: Creating a process to follow in case of a failed payment by account holders. Create rules and regulations for the account holder who has failed to make at least the minimum monthly payment by the due date.

elements.name: Analyze delinquent account balances
elements.definition: Examining balance statements of accountholders who failed to make required payments. Study or review the account details of customers' past payments when preparing negotiations policies.

elements.name: Correspond/Negotiate with delinquent accounts
elements.definition: Determine ways for customers in default to repay debts (e.g., allowing more time or discounts).

elements.name: Discuss account resolution with internal parties
elements.definition: Determining rules for handling accounts. Discuss and plan with internal parties (department heads, managers, and senior management) about rules to follow in coming months.

elements.name: Process adjustments/write off balances
elements.definition: Maintaining reserves for write-offs and adjustments. Adjust or write off certain expenses and losses.

elements.name: Perform recovery workout
elements.definition: Renegotiating the terms of a loan agreement in order to recoup money from a default account.

elements.name: Manage default accounts
elements.definition: Managing accounts that have not met the requirements agreed upon to pay off outstanding debts.

elements.name: Manage and process adjustments/deductions
elements.definition: Creating and providing funds for necessary adjustments and deductions, including all expenses that were required for the business at certain point in time.

elements.name: Establish policies/procedures for adjustments
elements.definition: Creating guidelines to follow in case of adjustments to business processes.

elements.name: Analyze adjustments
elements.definition: Checking changes made in accounts during the year. Examine the alterations made in final accounts to rectify errors/omissions.

elements.name: Correspond/Negotiate with customer
elements.definition: Providing suitable offers to customers. Present different offers (e.g., discounts) available for customers or buyers.

elements.name: Discuss resolution with internal parties
elements.definition: Discussing and planning with internal parties (department heads, managers, and senior management) about rules to follow in coming months.

elements.name: Prepare chargeback invoices
elements.definition: Creating a mechanism for consumer protection in case of a higher price charged. When a supplier sells a product at a higher price to the distributor than the price they have set with the end user, submit a chargeback to the supplier to recover the money lost in the transaction.

elements.name: Process related entries
elements.definition: Recording business transactions as they occur in order to provide a balanced accounts for financial reporting.

elements.name: Manage denials
elements.definition: Managing the amount of claims that are denied in the adjudication process by the insurance companies. To manage denials, providers should address the deficiency with the insurance companies or else the denial financial amounts need to be written off to bad debt.

elements.name: Review A/R and account aging queue
elements.definition: Managing the facility's accounts receivable so that there is proper and periodic review on the A/R so that is does not need to be written off.

elements.name: Perform retrospective denial reporting
elements.definition: Monitoring the denial trends to detect a documentation or care delivery gap.  Denial reporting typically organizes information by denial reasoning and aging buckets.

elements.name: Work underpayments, denials and rejections
elements.definition: Following up with payors and sometimes even the guarantor to collect outstanding accounts receivables due to underpayment, denials or rejections. Follow-up methods can include phone calls, e-mails, letters and other.

elements.name: Perform re-bill and appeals
elements.definition: Rebilling the payers for claims that were initially denied or appealed.

elements.name: Perform general accounting and reporting
elements.definition: Making statements about business activities and functions. Prepare financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, statement of cash flows, and statement of stockholders' equity) according to accounting concepts and principles.

elements.name: Manage policies and procedures
elements.definition: Creating procedures to perform general accounting and reporting. Follow the rules and regulations made for a particular process in the business. Publish accounting policies.

elements.name: Negotiate service-level agreements
elements.definition: Agreeing upon terms and conditions. Negotiate an agreement between two or more parties, the customer and service providers. Specify scope, quality, and responsibilities.

elements.name: Establish accounting policies
elements.definition: Establishing policies and procedures to prepare financial statements, including methods, measurement systems, and procedures for providing disclosures.

elements.name: Publish accounting policies
elements.definition: Creating a written copy of agreed-upon procedures for preparing financial statements, and making them available to the public.

elements.name: Set and enforce approval limits
elements.definition: Implementing parameters for accounting. Apply set conditions for any approval process.

elements.name: Establish common financial systems
elements.definition: Establishing processes and procedures to exercise financial control and accountability. Record, verify, and report transactions that affect revenues, expenditures, assets, and liabilities.

elements.name: Perform general accounting
elements.definition: Applying basic principles, concepts, and accounting practices in recording and preparing final accounts, and using accounting information in management.

elements.name: Maintain chart of accounts
elements.definition: Preparing trial balance account from general ledgers. List all accounts used in the general ledger. Alter accounts according to business requirements.

elements.name: Process journal entries
elements.definition: Making ledger and trial balance accounts from journal entries. This process requires the organization to record every transaction into accounts done by business. It is a base documents for preparing final accounts of company.

elements.name: Process allocations
elements.definition: Allocating funds across functions. Apportion funds in line with the budgets created. Formalize allocations in centralized internal records.

elements.name: Process period end adjustments
elements.definition: Updating journal entries to adjust the balance of income and expenses at the end of an accounting period.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Process period end adjustments (e.g., accruals and currency conversions)
elements.renamed_was: Process period end adjustments (e.g., accruals and currency conversions)

elements.name: Post and reconcile intercompany transactions
elements.definition: Checking accounts separately for a parent and subsidiary company. Manage relationship between a parent company and subsidiaries. Document intercompany transactions in separate financial statements.

elements.name: Reconcile general ledger accounts
elements.definition: Reviewing general ledger accounts for a parent and subsidiaries companies. Validate the integrity of account balances on the company's general ledger of accounts. Review and compare general ledger accounts balances with source documents to ensure that balances match.

elements.name: Perform consolidations and process eliminations
elements.definition: Aggregating different processes in the business. Eliminate discontinued processes.

elements.name: Prepare trial balance
elements.definition: Balancing debit and credit balances of trial balance to preparing final accounts. Calculate the total debits and credits in company's accounts. Correspond the sum of all debits with the sum of all credits. Adjust entries as appropriate.

elements.name: Prepare and post management adjustments
elements.definition: Accounting for changes due to country-level policy changes. Record adjustments made by management in the accounts.

elements.name: Perform fixed-asset accounting
elements.definition: Accounting for long-term and fixed assets. Record purchased, fixed assets that are not easily convertible into cash. Account for costs, useful life, resale value, depreciation, and amortization.

elements.name: Establish fixed-asset policies and procedures
elements.definition: Creating rules for fixed assets market valuation. Make rules and regulations for fixed assets regarding depreciation, provisions, resale, usage, etc.

elements.name: Maintain fixed-asset master data files
elements.definition: Keeping reports up-to-date regarding fixed assets. Create a fixed assets database detailing price, life cycle, depreciation rate, resale value, installation information, usage information, etc.

elements.name: Process and record fixed-asset additions and retires
elements.definition: Keeping a summary of sales and purchases of assets. Record any expenses made for new assets purchased and sales of any old assets during the fiscal year.

elements.name: Process and record fixed-asset adjustments, enhancements, revaluations, and transfers
elements.definition: Keeping a summary of expenses for installing and modifying assets.
