Record any expenses made for new assets purchased, any expenses incurred on improvements, the valuation of assets to reach current market price, and any transfer assets from one location to another during the fiscal year.

elements.name: Process and record fixed-asset maintenance and repair expenses
elements.definition: Maintaining a record of expenses necessitated for repairs and the preservation of assets. Administer and oversee the maintenance and repair of any fixed assets. Record all related transactions.

elements.name: Calculate and record depreciation expense
elements.definition: Carrying out accounting for depreciation over fixed assets. Compute the sums necessitated. Maintain a record of the cost value of fixed assets over their useful life in the book of accounts.

elements.name: Reconcile fixed-asset ledger
elements.definition: Balancing the ledger account balance for fixed assets. Correct errors in the books of fixed assets. Provide correct information in relevant accounts.

elements.name: Track fixed-assets including physical inventory
elements.definition: Checking and updating the record of all raw materials and fixed assets. Track all fixes asset. Maintain a record of all inventory items.

elements.name: Provide fixed-asset data to support tax, statutory, and regulatory reporting
elements.definition: Showing market value and related expenses on fixed assets data for taxation. Provide complete information recorded in the books of fixed assets about purchase price, depreciation, installation charges, resale market value etc. for tax and regulatory purposes.

elements.name: Perform financial reporting
elements.definition: Reporting on the organization's financial status to stakeholders. Include balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and statements of shareholders' equity.

elements.name: Prepare business unit financial statements
elements.definition: Making reports of subsidiaries units to show profits generated from them. Prepare financial statements (balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements and statements of shareholders' equity) for a single unit of a business.

elements.name: Prepare consolidated financial statements
elements.definition: Making final accounts for all units of company together. Prepare combined financial statements of a parent company and its subsidiaries (i.e., separate legal entities controlled by a parent company) showing assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses, and cash flows.

elements.name: Perform business unit reporting/review management reports
elements.definition: Making reports for units/subsidiaries to help management in decision making. Prepare financial statements (balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and statements of shareholders' equity) for a single unit of a business. Break down profits and losses by function/unit, clients, products, and region.

elements.name: Perform consolidated reporting/review of cost management reports
elements.definition: Making reports for all units to help higher management in decision making. Prepare combined financial statements of a parent company and its all subsidiaries (separate legal entities controlled by a parent company) showing assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses and cash flows, and also going through periodic reports which shows the actual and estimated costs and their variances.

elements.name: Prepare statements for board review
elements.definition: Preparing a draft of financial statements for the board to review before they are sent to the auditor.

elements.name: Produce quarterly/annual filings and shareholder reports
elements.definition: Making and presenting financial reports to stakeholders. Create annual and quarterly financial statements for reporting purposes. Prepare shareholder reports with details of the profit-and-loss account, balance sheet, and past year's business activities.

elements.name: Produce regulatory reports
elements.definition: Reporting raw or summary data for final accounts following rules and regulations.

elements.name: Perform legal and management consolidation
elements.definition: Carrying out activities associated with legal and management consolidation. Legal consolidation can include currency conversion, balance carry forward, and consolidation of journal entries. Management consolidation can include reporting on financials on a reporting cycle basis to gauge the performance of the organization.

elements.name: Manage fixed-asset project accounting
elements.definition: Managing accounts for large funds-invested projects. Manage and account for fixed assets projects (capital projects), which required significant capital investments over many years.

elements.name: Perform capital planning and project approval
elements.definition: Preparing a project finance report to solicit approvals in capital projects. Prepare budgets for projects that require heavy investments. Report on project finances to solicit approvals from management.

elements.name: Develop capital investment policies and procedures
elements.definition: Creating procedures and policies to follow for investing in capital projects. Create rules and regulations regarding large investment plans, which require in-depth forecasting for expenditure and revenue.

elements.name: Develop and approve capital expenditure plans and budgets
elements.definition: Creating budgets, and soliciting approvals for capital projects. Prepare budgets for projects that require heavy investments. Secure approvals from management.

elements.name: Review and approve capital projects and fixed-asset acquisitions
elements.definition: Evaluating and supporting capital investments in projects and fixed assets. Confirm details of capital projects. Secure approvals from managements for large investments.

elements.name: Conduct financial justification for project approval
elements.definition: Reviewing all project business cases in order to substantiate projected financial gains. Validate any project's business case. Juxtapose the benefits derived from moving a project forward against the associated costs.

elements.name: Perform capital project accounting
elements.definition: Accounting for large-scale and large-cost investments. Manage and account for ongoing activities related to capital projects, including setting up new projects, recording project transactions, monitoring and tracking spending, closing and capitalizing projects, and measuring the financial returns on completed projects.

elements.name: Create project account codes
elements.definition: Giving reference codes for every project.

elements.name: Record project-related transactions
elements.definition: Noting every transaction during a project in a common financial database. Document all transactions associated with any project. Maintain a centralized repository of all such financial data.

elements.name: Monitor and track capital projects and budget spending
elements.definition: Evaluating project progress and funds invested. Observe and track significant funds invested on any long-term project. Compare to budget.

elements.name: Close/capitalize projects
elements.definition: Checking for returns generated from projects for decision making. Evaluate capital projects that require heavy investments. Decide whether to proceed based on the revenues generated.

elements.name: Measure financial returns on completed capital projects
elements.definition: Comparing a finished project's profitability with forecasted returns. Scrutinize revenues generated by completed projects that required heavy investments. Determine profitability.

elements.name: Process payroll
elements.definition: Handling reporting time, managing pay, and processing taxes from salaries. Pay employees. Withhold taxes. Confirm the correct funds are paid to the correct government agency.

elements.name: Report time
elements.definition: Recording the reporting time of employees on-site. Track working days, salary calculations, holidays taken, number of hours spend in the office, billing hours, etc.

elements.name: Establish policies and procedures
elements.definition: Developing policies and procedures for the HR function to calculate compensation.

elements.name: Collect and record employee time worked
elements.definition: Tracking billing hours of each employee on daily basis.

elements.name: Analyze and report paid and unpaid leave
elements.definition: Tracking leaves allowed and taken by employees.

elements.name: Monitor regular, overtime, and other hours
elements.definition: Observing the number of hours worked by an employees on daily basis. Track the number of hours worked by an employee, as well as the number of hours worked beyond normal working hour's according to company standards.

elements.name: Analyze and report employee utilization
elements.definition: Monitoring the number of productive hours for employees.

elements.name: Manage pay
elements.definition: Managing the total payments made in employees payroll, including bonuses and compensation.

elements.name: Enter employee time worked into payroll system
elements.definition: Tracking the number of hours worked for the payroll system. Register the number of hours worked by an employee into the payroll system for the purpose of calculating salaries or wages.

elements.name: Maintain and administer employee earnings information
elements.definition: Tracking and oversee salary breakups of employees. This process requires the organization to manage and update information pertaining to the structure of every employee's salary. This would involve the updating any changes to the salary structures of the employees, in a central repository which can be accessed by pertinent departments.

elements.name: Maintain and administer applicable deductions
elements.definition: Processing salary deductions for tax purposes. Keep and manage the details of every employee's salary deductions based on their expenses and investments during the year.

elements.name: Monitor changes in tax status of employees
elements.definition: Tracking changes in the salary structure of employees for tax deductions.

elements.name: Process and distribute payments
elements.definition: Processing and distributing salaries to all employees. Execute the payroll management function through the dispensation of employee salaries. Leverage a centralized database of all payroll expenses.

elements.name: Process and distribute manual checks
elements.definition: Handling incorrect/omitted salary payments.

elements.name: Process period-end adjustments
elements.definition: Adjusting salary deductions for tax purposes at the end of the year.

elements.name: Respond to employee payroll inquiries
elements.definition: Addressing salary-related queries raised by employees.

elements.name: Manage and process payroll taxes
elements.definition: Deducting and paying taxes from employees' salaries.

elements.name: Develop tax plan
elements.definition: Devising a method to minimize payroll tax liability by means of allowances, deductions, exclusions or exemptions.

elements.name: Manage tax plan
elements.definition: Overseeing maintaining the reduction of payroll taxes [14075].

elements.name: Calculate and pay applicable payroll taxes
elements.definition: Paying tax according to appropriate deductions made from salaries. Calculate and pay the tax liabilities according to the salaries and tax regulations of employees with the help of certified chartered accountants.

elements.name: Produce and distribute employee annual tax statements
elements.definition: Providing tax deductions statements created by certified chartered accountants to every employee for their reference or refunds.

elements.name: File regulatory payroll tax forms
elements.definition: Filling taxes, and highlighting different sources of income and expenditures made.

elements.name: Process accounts payable and expense reimbursements
elements.definition: Handling bills and reimbursements to be made. Make payments for goods or services taken or used on behalf of the organization.

elements.name: Process accounts payable (AP)
elements.definition: Processing payments of operating expenses and other supplier charges. This includes the development of policies and procedures around processing of accounts payable and all operations. This process is often supported by key technology enablers.

elements.name: Verify AP pay file with purchase order vendor master file
elements.definition: Matching records of bills to be paid with accounts. Check accounts payable entries with vendor's account for every payment made.

elements.name: Maintain/Manage electronic commerce
elements.definition: Tracking all online transactions.

elements.name: Audit invoices and key data in AP system
elements.definition: Monitoring and evaluating bills registered in accounts books. Check all invoices. Maintain records.

elements.name: Approve payments
elements.definition: Processing payments for products/services.

elements.name: Process financial accruals and reversals
elements.definition: Handling transactions for accruals and reversals. Record transactions in the books of accounts on an accrual basis (irrespective of the actual cash flow) and reversals basis (cancel out the adjusting entries) for balancing accounts.

elements.name: Process payables taxes
elements.definition: Filing the amount of taxes that a company owes as of the balance sheet date. Prepare tax returns, including the income tax filing for an individual or business entity from earnings.

elements.name: Research/Resolve payable exceptions
elements.definition: Resolving any atypical or inconsistent situation concerning payments to be made by the organization. Address any exceptional case of accounts payable on an ad hoc basis, by seeking counsel or carrying out any necessary research.

elements.name: Process payments
elements.definition: Making payments for products/services on due dates (payment cycle) decided by parties involved.

elements.name: Respond to AP inquiries
elements.definition: Clarifying or address queries relating to the particulars of AP such as date, discounts, amount, and installments. Coordinate with concerned parties about the fulfillment of bills payable.

elements.name: Retain records
elements.definition: Keeping bills of every transaction for future reference.

elements.name: Adjust accounting records
elements.definition: Rectifying for alterations occurred in accounts while recording.

elements.name: Process expense reimbursements
elements.definition: Processing reimbursements to employees for the expenses incurred during the course of business. Approve and process advancements and reimbursements for employee expenses on the organization's behalf. Capture and report relevant tax data and manage personal accounts.

elements.name: Establish and communicate expense reimbursement policies and approval limits
elements.definition: Explaining policies and procedures related to reimbursements requests by employees. Set policies regarding reimbursement process and amount limits etc. Inform employees.

elements.name: Capture and report relevant tax data
elements.definition: Collecting and reporting all pertinent information regarding the taxes paid by the organization's employees.

elements.name: Approve reimbursements and advances
elements.definition: Permitting expense reimbursement requests from employees.

elements.name: Process reimbursements and advances
elements.definition: Paying for expense reimbursement requests from employees. (Follow Approve reimbursements and advances [10882] according to policies and conditions.)

elements.name: Manage personnel accounts
elements.definition: Maintaining accounts of individuals who are connected with business.

elements.name: Manage corporate credit cards
elements.definition: Handling and authoring credit cards to business entities or for corporate purchases.

elements.name: Establish corporate credit card policies and approval limits
elements.definition: Developing procedures for using company credit cards. Set or approve credit limits.

elements.name: Process corporate credit card requests
elements.definition: Handling applications credit card applications for business expenses.

elements.name: Order corporate credit cards
elements.definition: Obtaining credit cards for business-related expenses.

elements.name: Manage corporate credit card accounts
elements.definition: Handling credit card accounts of business customers.

elements.name: Approve/Change credit limits
elements.definition: Authorizing changes to the available credit advances.

elements.name: Cancel/Deactivate credit card
elements.definition: Blocking an existing credit card to disable all future transactions.

elements.name: Manage treasury operations
elements.definition: Managing business's investments in trading in bonds, currencies, financial derivatives, etc. Manage the financial assets and holdings of the organization. Optimize the organization's liquidity. Invest excess cash. Reduce financial risks.

elements.name: Manage treasury policies and procedures
elements.definition: Managing rules and regulations for investments in trading in bonds, currencies, financial derivatives, etc. Establish policies and procedures for investments made. Optimize liquidity in treasury operations.

elements.name: Establish scope and governance of treasury operations
elements.definition: Selecting opportunities and the authoritative body for investments in trading in bonds, currencies, financial derivatives, etc.

elements.name: Establish and publish treasury policies
elements.definition: Creating and providing investment regulations for the organization. Establish policies and procedures for investments to optimize liquidity in treasury operations. Create a written copy of it.

elements.name: Develop treasury procedures
elements.definition: Making processes for investing. Create steps for investments in bonds, currencies, and financial derivatives in order to optimize company's liquidity, invest excess cash, and reduce its financial risks.

elements.name: Monitor treasury procedures
elements.definition: Checking treasury processes in order to optimize company's liquidity, invest excess cash, and reduce its financial risks.

elements.name: Audit treasury procedures
elements.definition: Auditing the treasury function.

elements.name: Revise treasury procedures
elements.definition: Reassessing all treasury procedures based on audit findings.

elements.name: Develop and confirm internal controls for treasury
elements.definition: Creating and managing the internal control systems for investments in bonds, currencies, and financial derivatives to verify procedures.

elements.name: Define system security requirements
elements.definition: Describing the need of system security requirements for controlling access, reliability of information, accountability, and availability of information in the organization.

elements.name: Manage cash
elements.definition: Taking care of all cash-related activities in the business. Manage and reconcile cash positions. Manage cash equivalents. Process and oversee electronic fund transfers. Develop cash flow forecasts. Manage cash flows. Produce cash management accounting transactions and reports. Manage and oversee banking relationships. Analyze, negotiate, resolve, and confirm bank fees.

elements.name: Manage and reconcile cash positions
elements.definition: Correcting cash differences in the books of accounts. Make optimum utilization of funds available in the business. Check for differences to rectify.

elements.name: Manage cash equivalents
elements.definition: Taking care of all cash-related activities in the business. Utilize short-term assets that can be easily convertible into cash, such as marketable securities, commercial paper and short-term government bonds, and treasury bills.

elements.name: Process and oversee electronic fund transfers (EFTs)
elements.definition: Supervising all online transactions.

elements.name: Develop cash flow forecasts
elements.definition: Preparing forecasts for the cash generated or used by the organization.

elements.name: Manage cash flows
elements.definition: Delaying the outflow of funds as long as possible, but encourage the inflow of as fast as possible.

elements.name: Produce cash management accounting transactions and reports
elements.definition: Presenting reports on all cash-related activities. Collect and manage short-term investing activities. Prepare reports of all transactions done.

elements.name: Manage and oversee banking relationships
elements.definition: Maintaining and directing the course of relationships with banking partners.

elements.name: Analyze, negotiate, resolve, and confirm bank fees
elements.definition: Studying and finalizing bank fees for services provided by banks. Negotiate and finalize nominal fees that bank charges for various services, such as requesting a deposit slip or counter check or certifying papers.

elements.name: Manage in-house bank accounts
elements.definition: Managing financial services provided by an in-house bank structure in the corporation that is operating like a commercial bank.

elements.name: Manage in-house bank accounts for subsidiaries
elements.definition: Maintaining subsidiaries' company accounts opened with bank inside the corporation. Manage different financial services provided by in-house bank structure for parent companies' subsidiaries or branches.

elements.name: Manage and facilitate inter-company borrowing transactions
elements.definition: Arranging loans for subsidiaries from in-house banks.

elements.name: Manage centralized outgoing payments on behalf of subsidiaries
elements.definition: Handling payments made for subsidiaries by parent company.

elements.name: Manage central incoming payments on behalf of subsidiaries
elements.definition: Handling payments received by parent company for subsidiaries.

elements.name: Manage internal payments and netting transactions
elements.definition: Taking care of all business outflows and recording as whole. Manage making all payments for the organization and its units or subsidiaries. Track in books of accounts of parent company.

elements.name: Calculate interest and fees for in-house bank accounts
elements.definition: Computing all expenses paid to and receivables collected over the organization's banking activity. Calculate all charges and receivables, towards interest, fees, and any other payments over its own bank accounts. Record transactions in the books of accounts.

elements.name: Provide account statements for in-house bank accounts
elements.definition: Facilitating account statements for all in-house banking activity.

elements.name: Manage debt and investment
elements.definition: Taking care of the organization's financial position. Manage its loans or debts from different sources and investments. Leverage the most profitable options to balance the financial position in the market.

elements.name: Establish investment policy
elements.definition: Developing and instituting principles that the organization ill use in making investments.

elements.name: Manage financial intermediary relationships
elements.definition: Maintaining smooth relations with financial investment banks that help availing loans and services.

elements.name: Manage liquidity
elements.definition: Managing and maintaining enough liquidity in form of cash and cash equivalents in the business to meet urgent and timely requirements

elements.name: Manage issuer exposure
elements.definition: Managing the exposure incurred by the issuer for providing credit to the borrower.

elements.name: Process and oversee debt and investment transactions
elements.definition: Tracking loans taken and money invested in different options. Arrange and supervise loans from banks and individuals and investments in different available and profitable options.

elements.name: Process and oversee foreign currency transactions
elements.definition: Arranging and supervising foreign exchange rate changes to avoid loss on foreign-currency transactions.

elements.name: Produce debt and investment accounting transaction reports
elements.definition: Creating transactions report of loans and investments. Prepare and maintain records of loans and investment transactions.

elements.name: Process and oversee interest rate transactions
elements.definition: Supervising the interest paid or received by the organization. Arrange and supervise interest rate swap transactions to manage exposure to fluctuations in interest rates. Or attain a marginally lower rate of interest than could be gained through a swap.

elements.name: Monitor and execute risk and hedging transactions
elements.definition: Performing transactions that limit investment risk with the help of derivatives, such as options and futures contracts. Manage interest rates, foreign exchange, and exposure risks. Develop and execute hedging transactions. Evaluate and refine hedging positions. Produce hedge accounting transactions and reports. Monitor credit.

elements.name: Develop risk management/hedging strategy
elements.definition: Taking an investment position to offset exposure to certain risks. This may include purchasing opposite of the organization's position in the marketplace, using derivatives transactions, or futures contracts.

elements.name: Manage interest rate risk
elements.definition: Handling risks arising from changes in the interest rate.

elements.name: Manage interest rate market data
elements.definition: Collecting and storing data that pertains to interest rate markets.

elements.name: Determine interest rate exposure for all markets
elements.definition: Identifying potential interest rate risks for all markets.

elements.name: Determine interest rate hedge requirements in accordance with risk policy
elements.definition: Deciding the requirements on interest rate investments that are made by trading in futures or options market, on the basis of the accepted risk policy.

elements.name: Execute interest rate trades
elements.definition: Performing trading on interest rates.

elements.name: Manage foreign exchange risk
elements.definition: Taking care of foreign-exchange risks.

elements.name: Manage foreign exchange market data
elements.definition: Handling and processing information about changes in foreign exchange rates.

elements.name: Determine foreign exchange exposure for all currencies
elements.definition: Establishing potential foreign exchange risks for all currencies.

elements.name: Determine foreign exchange hedge requirements in accordance with risk policy
elements.definition: Deciding the requirements on investments in foreign exchange made by trading in futures or options market, on the basis of current risk policy.

elements.name: Execute foreign exchange trades
elements.definition: Executing all aspects for foreign exchange trade within foreign exchange market. This includes buying, selling, and exchanging currencies at the current or expressed price point.

elements.name: Manage foreign exchange balance sheet risk
elements.definition: Overseeing the foreign exchange balance sheet with an eye towards potential risk. Risks include changes in conversion rates between the time the transaction occurred and when it is completed, or when transactions are made in a denomination other than that of the organization's base currency.

elements.name: Manage exposure risk
elements.definition: Taking care of exposure risks. Maintain financial investments in particular investments or a portfolios that could be risky for the organization.

elements.name: Determine current customer exposures and limit exceptions
elements.definition: Establishing ongoing risks that the customers face, and the exceptions to exceeded limits.

elements.name: Resolve customer exposure limit violations
elements.definition: Settling cases that involve violations of customer exposure limit.

elements.name: Manage customer collateral
elements.definition: Handling customer securities to recover loans that are not paid back.

elements.name: Perform annual customer credit reviews
elements.definition: Conducting reviews to assess customer credit on a yearly basis. Introduce changes or make recommendations, if needed.

elements.name: Execute hedging transactions
elements.definition: Implementing hedging strategy in attempt to alleviate risk. This will include all options, depravities, and futures contracts agreed upon in Develop risk management/hedging strategy [12974].

elements.name: Measure physical positions
elements.definition: Evaluating investments made in some market to offset the risks of investing in a contrary or opposing market.

elements.name: Establish hedges
elements.definition: Determining which hedge options to execute.

elements.name: Unwind hedges
elements.definition: Closing out a position or cashing in derivatives early.

elements.name: Evaluate and refine hedging positions
elements.definition: Examining options in the market for hedging investments. Select an option.

elements.name: Monitor credit
elements.definition: Revising credit reports periodically for accurateness and changes that could be suggestive of duplicitous activity.

elements.name: Produce hedge accounting transactions and reports
elements.definition: Preparing and documenting accounts and records of all hedging investment transactions to reduce risks due to change in markets.

elements.name: Manage financial fraud/dispute cases
elements.definition: Handling cases that involve financial fraud. Resolve disputes.

elements.name: Manage internal controls
elements.definition: Administering internal controls. This process requires the organization to manage entity's board of trustees, management, and other personnel in order to offer judicious assurance about the achievement of effectiveness, proficiency of operations, and reliability of financial reporting.

elements.name: Establish internal controls, policies, and procedures
elements.definition: Forming rules and regulations to ensure the achievement of effectiveness, proficiency of operations, and reliability of financial reporting.

elements.name: Establish board of directors and audit committee
elements.definition: Establishing board of directors and auditing committee in order to assign roles and responsibilities for internal controls.

elements.name: Define and communicate code of ethics
elements.definition: Outlining and communicating a code of ethics act responsibly.

elements.name: Assign roles and responsibility for internal controls
elements.definition: Defining roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities for effectiveness and proficiency of operations and reliability of financial reporting.

elements.name: Define business process objectives and risks
elements.definition: Outlining the objectives and risks associated with a process. Delineate process goals. Determine the risks attached to it. Determine what the process is meant to accomplish, potential issues, a timeline of potential risks, the scope and potential impact of risks, etc.

elements.name: Define entity/unit risk tolerances
elements.definition: Outlining the risk tolerance levels of individual units, as well as the organization as a whole. Determine the specific maximum risk to take in quantitative terms for each relevant risk subcategory, including strategic, operational, financial, and compliance risks.

elements.name: Operate controls and monitor compliance with internal controls policies and procedures
elements.definition: Incorporating planning, management, operations, and monitoring of internal control mechanism policies and procedures in order to manage internal controls. Design and implement control activities. Monitor control effectiveness. Remediate control deficiencies. Create compliance functions. Operate compliance functions. Implement and maintain technologies and tools to enable the internal controls-related activities.

elements.name: Design and implement control activities
elements.definition: Defining and executing policies, procedures, techniques, and mechanisms and actions taken to minimize risk.

elements.name: Monitor control effectiveness
elements.definition: Overseeing the activities for internal controls. Observe the effectiveness of policies, procedures, techniques, and mechanisms actions taken to minimize risk.

elements.name: Remediate control deficiencies
elements.definition: Taking corrective measures for policies, procedures, techniques, and mechanisms actions taken to minimize risk. (Conduct in accordance with Monitor control effectiveness [10918] in order to determine and rectify the control deficiencies.)

elements.name: Create compliance function
elements.definition: Developing a compliance function for internal controls. Monitor trading activity. Avoid conflicts of interest. Safeguard compliance with guidelines at brokerage houses. Avoid money laundering and potential tax evasion.

elements.name: Operate compliance function
elements.definition: Administering operational activities of a compliance function.

elements.name: Implement and maintain controls-related enabling technologies and tools
elements.definition: Implementing and maintaining the compliance technological systems or equipment that are control-enabled.

elements.name: Report on internal controls compliance
elements.definition: Reporting on internal controls compliance to the appropriate authority, including IT regulations and pertinent data.

elements.name: Report to external auditors
elements.definition: Reporting to external auditors. This process requires the organization to report to external auditors about the regulations for any critical data that the organization is holding.

elements.name: Report to regulators, share-/debt-holders, securities exchanges, etc.
elements.definition: Reporting to regulators, shareholders, debt holders, securities exchanges, etc. about IT regulations and pertinent data.

elements.name: Report to third parties
elements.definition: Reporting to suppliers, customers, and partners that are doing business with the company about IT regulations and pertinent data.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Report to third parties (e.g., business partners)
elements.renamed_was: Report to third parties (e.g., business partners)

elements.name: Report to internal management
elements.definition: Reporting to internal management (all employees, directors, and management) about IT regulations and pertinent data.

elements.name: Manage taxes
elements.definition: Estimating the organization's periodic tax liabilities. Ensure that appropriate taxing authorities receive tax return filings and payments when due.

elements.name: Develop tax strategy and plan
elements.definition: Setting targets for periodic tax liabilities. Assess the tax impact of various activities such as the acquisition or disposal of fixed assets or a deliberate change in number of employee.

elements.name: Develop foreign, national, state, and local tax strategy
elements.definition: Developing a tax strategy for foreign, national, state, local administration. Set up tax strategies for foreign trade in imports and exports and at national, state, and local level.

elements.name: Consolidate and optimize total tax plan
elements.definition: Combining and enhancing a rational analysis of a financial condition or plan from a tax perspective in order to align financial goals through efficient tax planning.

elements.name: Maintain tax master data
elements.definition: Maintaining a master file about the rational analysis of a financial condition or plan from a tax perspective in order to align financial goals through efficient tax planning.

elements.name: Process taxes
elements.definition: Processing the taxes of the organization in line with the regional taxation structure, including corporate, property, excise, and service taxes.

elements.name: Perform tax planning/strategy
elements.definition: Creating and implementing strategies for taxes to be paid or collected by the business.

elements.name: Prepare tax returns
elements.definition: Preparing and submitting tax reports for every employee to the tax department in order to show the tax paid and deducted from their salaries in the year.

elements.name: Prepare foreign taxes
elements.definition: Preparing reports about paid or accrued foreign taxes to an overseas country.

elements.name: Calculate deferred taxes
elements.definition: Calculating the income that has been realized when the tax on that income has not.

elements.name: Account for taxes
elements.definition: Managing the organization's financial accounts for the purpose of taxation. Prepare and maintain the tax paid by the organization to the country they have business in.

elements.name: Monitor tax compliance
elements.definition: Checking and correcting the tax policies according to the rules and regulations set by the organization.

elements.name: Address tax inquiries
elements.definition: Addressing any tax queries by any regulatory or government authorities. Review historical records related to taxation within the organization in order to respond to queries.

elements.name: Manage international funds/consolidation
elements.definition: Managing cash collections and disbursements made by operating units across the enterprise. When appropriate, transfer cash from the operating units to parent-level bank accounts managed by the organization's treasury team.

elements.name: Monitor international rates
elements.definition: Forecasting and monitoring changes in foreign currency value or interest rates around the world that play an important role in the organization.

elements.name: Manage transactions
elements.definition: Managing any transfer of funds in the course of conducting cross-border trades or investments, including conversion across currencies. Find the most suitable alternative for making payments, while saving taxes and avoiding any unwarranted regulation, with the objective of protecting capital.

elements.name: Monitor currency exposure/hedge currency
elements.definition: Assessing exposure to potential financial losses as a result of changes in the value of currencies. Forecast the impact of movements in foreign currency values. Enter into financial transactions designed to offset or limit potential exposure to loss.

elements.name: Report results
elements.definition: Documenting and reporting accounting entries to formally report financial gains or losses experienced as a result of foreign exchange activity.

elements.name: Perform global trade services
elements.definition: Making and collecting payments for transactions in products/services, and transporting them to interested markets.

elements.name: Screen sanctioned party list
elements.definition: Evaluating the approved list of parties for engaging in international trade in order to ensure the safety of the organization's business transactions. Examine agents that have been granted legal rights to engage in global trade and their credentials.

elements.name: Control exports and imports
elements.definition: Overseeing and directing the flow of trade to/from the organization in order to ensure financial gains.

elements.name: Classify products
elements.definition: Systematically categorizing products/services for their suitability to international trade. Create classes and categories for demarcating the types of products suitable for international trade. Study requisite national and international standards and the adherence of the organization's portfolio of offerings to these.

elements.name: Perform currency conversion
elements.definition: Identifying current exchange rates between two currencies and converting the foreign currency to that of the local monetary unit. I.E., yen to US dollar.

elements.name: Calculate duty
elements.definition: Computing the excise duty to be paid during international trade.

elements.name: Communicate with customs
elements.definition: Communicating with the customs department to ensure fluid compliance. Share pertinent information mandated by law with the government agency that controls and collects the duties levied for the international exchange of products/services.

elements.name: Document trade
elements.definition: Documenting and recording the trade processes while making transactions, noting the description, quality, number, transportation medium, indemnity, and inspection.

elements.name: Process trade preferences
elements.definition: Preparing global trade under preference, which allows the organization to import/export products at a lower or nil rate of customs duty and/or levy charge.

elements.name: Handle restitution
elements.definition: Administering and overseeing all restitution activities the organization may be subjected to. Manage compliance with apposite legal frameworks. Make any restitution that may be required by law; comply with authorities over any fines or non-financial measures imposed.

elements.name: Prepare letter of credit
elements.definition: Creating a document assuring that a seller will receive payment when certain delivery conditions are met. (If the buyer is unable to make payment on the purchase, a bank covers the outstanding amount.)

elements.name: Acquire, Construct, and Manage Assets
elements.definition: Relating to the design, construction, acquisition, and management of both productive and non-productive assets.

elements.name: Plan and acquire assets
elements.definition: Building and purchasing non-productive assets for the organization. Acquire and construct non-productive assets that are not yielding any income/profits to the business.
elements.change_details: -10942, c10941, c10944, RENAME, WAS:Design and construct/acquire nonproductive assets

elements.name: Develop property strategy and long term vision
elements.definition: Strategizing a long-term vision for managing properties. Prepare strategies and a long-term vision for managing purchased/retained properties.
elements.change_details: -18888, c10956, c10957, RENAME, WAS:Develop property strategy and long-term vision
elements.renamed_was: Develop property strategy and long-term vision

elements.name: Confirm alignment of property requirements with business strategy
elements.definition: Creating alignment between the requirement of properties and the overall business strategy. This process requires the organization to align the requirement of properties in accordance with its business strategies of the organization.

elements.name: Appraise the external environment
elements.definition: Evaluating the impact of the external environment. Evaluate the circumstances, objects, events, and aspects surrounding an organization that affects its actions and selections and that recognizes its opportunities and risks.

elements.name: Determine build or buy decision
elements.definition: Deciding whether to buy or build properties. Study the market forces about property prices and cost of construction in order to take decisions based on the market research.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Make build, buy, or lease decision
elements.renamed_was: Make build, buy, or lease decision

elements.name: Plan facility
elements.definition: Recognizing the needs of facility users in order to construct a project proposal that meets those needs.

elements.name: Design facility
elements.definition: Preparing and analyzing different designs for a facility in order to finalize which design will be the most suitable option.

elements.name: Analyze budget
elements.definition: Evaluating the feasibility of budgets prepared for the construction of facilities.

elements.name: Select property
elements.definition: Assessing and choosing the appropriate property. Analyze the property requirements. Review the available property options. Finalize the most suitable option.

elements.name: Negotiate terms for facility
elements.definition: Discussing the terms and conditions of facilities to be occupied according to the business requirements and availability of budgets.

elements.name: Manage construction or modification to building
elements.definition: Constructing the buildings. Manage renovations according to requirements and demands.

elements.name: Provide workspace and facilities
elements.definition: Managing the provision of the workspace and its assets. Arrange an office space with all assets (tables, chairs, computers, admin staff, etc.) according to requirements.
elements.change_details: c10963, c10964, RENAME, WAS:Provide workspace and assets

elements.name: Acquire workspace and facilities
elements.definition: Attaining the office space with all assets (tables, chairs, computers, admin staff, etc.) according to requirements.

elements.name: Change fit/form/function of workspace and facilities
elements.definition: Modifying the formation of the workspace and its assets. Make necessary changes in an office space with all assets (tables, chairs, computers, admin staff, interior designing, etc.) according to requirements.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Change fit/form/function of workspace and assets
elements.renamed_was: Change fit/form/function of workspace and assets

elements.name: Manage facilities operations
elements.definition: Managing all operational activities of the facility. Manage how each function/business unit works. Support the manufacturing facility to attain organizational goals.

elements.name: Relocate people
elements.definition: Shifting staff or employees from one place to another place according to changes in business requirements.

elements.name: Relocate material and tools
elements.definition: Relocating the tools and raw materials. Shift raw or finished material and machines of company from one place to another place according to changes in business requirements.

elements.name: Design and construct productive assets
elements.definition: Conceptualizing and realizing dividend and income generating assets such as machines, tools, factories, etc. Manage steps to acquire assets including managing capital, as well as planning, scheduling, and overseeing construction.

elements.name: Manage capital program for productive assets
elements.definition: Producing and maintaining a planning schedule and a financial plan to purchase or manufacture productive assets. Determine the investment plan, monitor capital, and secure the necessary financing in order to realize completion of the program.

elements.name: Define capital investment plan
elements.definition: Establishing what funds will be invested in the construction of productive assets for the advancement of established business objectives.

elements.name: Monitor capital program
elements.definition: Monitoring plans on capital projects. Capital projects can be purchasing buildings, lands, etc.

elements.name: Secure construction financing
elements.definition: Acquiring the loans needed to construct necessary assets.

elements.name: Design and plan asset construction
elements.definition: Outlining the steps and strategies needed to construct assets. Verify that all regulations are adhered to and that all permissions have been granted. Organize and plan for resources to complete construction.

elements.name: Develop construction strategy
elements.definition: Developing a strategy to perform asset construction. Assure that timelines, regulations, and resources are on task and on budget.

elements.name: Perform construction performance management
elements.definition: Managing the construction process to ensure that activates are on task, on budget, and are being performed with safety and quality in mind.

elements.name: Obtain construction permissions
elements.definition: Gathering the required permits for construction from the proper jurisdiction. This may include inspections during and after construction to verify that the new asset meets all national, regional, and local codes.

elements.name: Design assets
elements.definition: Designing assets to meet organizational needs as well as ensuring that the asset adheres to all national, regional, and local construction codes.

elements.name: Plan construction resources
elements.definition: Determining what resources will need to be acquired in order to carry out construction. Plan when, where, and how resources will be used. Determine the length of time resources will be utilized.

elements.name: Schedule and perform construction work
elements.definition: Arranging a timetable for which to perform construction work. Schedule resources to contract assets for new or replacement assets. Reschedule or redesign assets if needed.

elements.name: Schedule construction work
elements.definition: Defining a timetable for which to execute the construction of the asset.

elements.name: Obtain resources
elements.definition: Gathering resources needed to complete all construction work. Verify that all resources have the proper training and skills to perform the work.

elements.name: Construct new assets
elements.definition: Building new assets necessary for the organization. Be aware of any construction codes and permits that need to be addressed.

elements.name: Augment existing assets
elements.definition: Modifying existing assets to align with the changing needs of the organization. Be aware of any construction codes and permits that need to be addressed.

elements.name: Renew/Replace assets
elements.definition: Determining the need to replace existing assets. Be aware of any construction codes and permits that need to be addressed.

elements.name: Manage asset construction
elements.definition: Overseeing the performance and quality of work. Assure that records are maintained throughout the construction process. Adhere to all safety, security, and access regulations set forth by the organization and all government standards.

elements.name: Monitor work performance
elements.definition: Monitoring construction to insure that all regulatory laws are being adhered to, that all work is being performed in a timely manner, and that quality assurance is met at all steps of the construction process.

elements.name: Undertake construction quality control
elements.definition: Implementing a checks and balances system to verify that the construction was performed correctly. Rework when errors are found.

elements.name: Create work and asset records
elements.definition: Implementing records to include all construction work that has been performed. Include all new or modified construction, and any construction or regulatory issues that might have occurred.

elements.name: Manage safety, security, and access to sites
elements.definition: Ensuring that safety, security, and access is maintained. Provide a workplace that meets and exceeds all local, state, and federal guidelines. Provide security and access to the building site as set forth by safety and organizational guidelines.

elements.name: Maintain productive assets
elements.definition: Preserving productive assets through the planning, managing, and performance of preventative, routine, and critical maintenance work.

elements.name: Plan asset maintenance
elements.definition: Ensuring that necessary resources are available and tasks are prioritized accordingly through planning. Provide strategies and policies that identify tasks that need to be completed, and the resources necessary to fulfill those tasks.

elements.name: Develop maintenance strategies
elements.definition: Creating goals and agendas to better realize the success of the maintenance policies that have been put into place.

elements.name: Analyze assets and predict maintenance requirements
elements.definition: Evaluating assets in order to project future requirements for maintenance. Evaluate the present working condition of assets. Determine the future maintenance requirements of assets.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Analyze assets, and predict maintenance requirements
elements.renamed_was: Analyze assets, and predict maintenance requirements

elements.name: Specify maintenance policies
elements.definition: Communicating policies in regards to asset maintenance. Provide a clear set of procedures and policies that outline what will be involved in the maintenance process.

elements.name: Integrate preventive maintenance into operations schedule
elements.definition: Devising a methodology and procedure for assimilating the works of planned maintenance into the schedule scheme for the processing of finished products that utilizes the same machinery.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Develop approach to integrate preventive maintenance into production schedule
elements.renamed_was: Develop approach to integrate preventive maintenance into production schedule

elements.name: Identify work management tasks & priorities
elements.definition: Identifying the steps needed for asset maintenance. List out the those tasks that are involved in completing this process. Prioritize the tasks that are created.

elements.name: Conduct resource planning
elements.definition: Analyzing workload needs in relation to asset maintenance and plan resources around those needs.

elements.name: Create work plans
elements.definition: Creating procedures on how to maintain productive assets.

elements.name: Manage asset maintenance
elements.definition: Ensuring that asset maintenance is conducted in a timely manner and successfully. Schedule work with the required resources with an eye on quality control and safety. Verify that contracted maintenance meets performance targets.

elements.name: Schedule maintenance work
elements.definition: Defining a timetable for which to execute the maintenance of the asset.

elements.name: Obtain required resources
elements.definition: Gathering resources needed to complete all maintenance work. Verify that all resources have the proper training and skills to perform the work.

elements.name: Undertake quality control
elements.definition: Implementing a checks and balances system to verify that the maintenance was performed correctly. Rework when errors are found.

elements.name: Update work and asset records
elements.definition: Modifying existing maintenance records to include all new work that has been performed, what assets were serviced, and any issues that might have arisen.

elements.name: Manage maintenance work safety
elements.definition: Assuring that all safety laws and regulations are being implemented and followed. Align practices with regulatory bureaus such as OSHA , EHS, and ISO.

elements.name: Define maintenance performance targets
elements.definition: Outlining what should be achieved through predictive indicators with regard to performing maintenance. This could include the length of time it takes to perform routine maintenance or how often unplanned maintenance feasibly occur.

elements.name: Monitor maintenance performance against targets/contracts
elements.definition: Following set performance targets, monitor and gage the success of the organization in meeting those targets.

elements.name: Perform asset maintenance
elements.definition: Engaging in all aspects of asset maintenance. Ensure that all assets are functioning properly and to all specified codes and regulations where applicable. Maintenance includes all preventative, routine, and corrective activates.

elements.name: Perform preventative asset maintenance
elements.definition: Performing prophylactic maintenance in an effort to avoid corrective or unplanned repairs.

elements.name: Perform routine asset maintenance
elements.definition: Carrying out required maintenance to continue upkeep of equipment or assets.

elements.name: Perform corrective asset maintenance and repairs
elements.definition: Repairing or correcting faults that occur with an asset. This could be a break or other repairable damage.

elements.name: Identify unplanned maintenance requirements
elements.definition: Realizing potential or current problems with assets that would require unplanned maintenance. Unplanned maintenance is a repair or change that needs to be made that is not preventative or routine.

elements.name: Perform unplanned maintenance and repairs
elements.definition: Performing repairs that occur outside of normal routine or preventative maintenance.

elements.name: Dispose of assets
elements.definition: Retiring productive and non-productive assets.
elements.change_details: +19258, +16970, RENAME, WAS:Dispose of productive and nonproductive assets
elements.renamed_was: Dispose of productive and nonproductive assets

elements.name: Develop exit strategy
elements.definition: Creating a strategy for managing asset exits.

elements.name: Decommission productive assets
elements.definition: Retiring assets that are no longer viable to the business. Decommission assets that are no longer in working order, are out of date, or whose maintenance exceeds the cost of replacement.

elements.name: Perform sale or trade
elements.definition: Performing the sale of assets. Achieve and complete the sale process. Deliver the end product to the customers.

elements.name: Perform abandonment
elements.definition: Abandoning assets. Manage the act of deliberately and permanently giving up, granting, leaving, or surrendering property or buildings and allowing others to use the intellectual property without protest.

elements.name: Perform waste and hazardous goods management
elements.definition: Disposing of waste and hazardous materials as outlined by state, local, and federal regulations.

elements.name: Manage real estate and space
elements.definition: Managing space for patient care and common areas. Providers optimize space for patient care.

elements.name: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
elements.definition: Ensuring that an organization effectively manages its risk. Process groups are aligned with traditional risk management activities.

elements.name: Manage enterprise risk
elements.definition: Creating requisite frameworks and coordinating all risk management activities for the entire organization and each function. Manage the enterprise risk by outlining the risk policies and procedures. Monitor and communicate all risk management activities. Encourage correspondence among the business units. Manage the risk of all business units and functions.

elements.name: Establish the enterprise risk framework and policies
elements.definition: Creating an agenda for the rules and regulations of enterprise risk that deal with hazardous, financial, operational, and strategic risks.

elements.name: Research risk policies from an outside legal perspective
elements.definition: Analyzing risk of hospitals performing clinical trials - especially involving humans - must meet specific criteria prior to beginning trials (informed consent, financial conflict of interest, researcher misconduct, etc.).

elements.name: Determine risk tolerance for organization
elements.definition: Recognizing the organization's tolerance for risk, given risk-return trade-offs for one or more anticipated and predictable consequences.

elements.name: Develop and maintain enterprise risk policies and procedures
elements.definition: Establishing and maintaining the policies and procedures for managing risk. Create rules and regulations for enterprise risk dealing with hazardous, financial, operational, and strategic risks.

elements.name: Identify and implement enterprise risk management tools
elements.definition: Recognizing and implementing tools for managing risk. Identify and apply enterprise risk management tools. Leverage methods and processes to manage risks and opportunities associated with business objectives.

elements.name: Coordinate the sharing of risk knowledge across the organization
elements.definition: Communicating the knowledge about risk within the organization. Identify operational risks. Share risk information within the organization.

elements.name: Prepare and report enterprise risk to executive management and board
elements.definition: Preparing and presenting reports about enterprise risk to the management of the organization. Create reports for management on hazard risks (e.g., property damage and liability torts), financial risks (e.g., currency and liquidity risks), and operational risks (e.g., product failure, customer satisfaction, social trends, and competition).

elements.name: Oversee and coordinate enterprise risk management activities
elements.definition: Coordinating to plan, organize, lead, and control the activities of an organization in order to minimize the special effects of risk on capital and earnings.

elements.name: Identify enterprise level risks
elements.definition: Determining risks that could thwart objectives. Document and communicate the concern.

elements.name: Assess risks to determine which to mitigate
elements.definition: Identifying options/actions to enhance opportunities and reduce threats. Recognize the root reasons of the identified risks.

elements.name: Develop risk mitigation and management strategy and integrate with existing performance management processes
elements.definition: Developing activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats. Specify the organization's objectives. Evolve strategies and policies to attain these objectives. Assign resources to project objectives.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Develop risk mitigation and management strategy, and integrate with existing performance management processes
elements.renamed_was: Develop risk mitigation and management strategy, and integrate with existing performance management processes

elements.name: Verify business unit and functional risk mitigation plans are implemented
elements.definition: Checking that the blueprint created for managing risk in individual business units and divisions is correctly effectuated. Validate the implementation of all activities geared to mitigate risks.

elements.name: Ensure risks and risk mitigation actions are monitored
elements.definition: Ensuring risk monitoring and mitigation activities. Monitor actions to enhance opportunities and reduce threats to project objectives.

elements.name: Report on enterprise risk activities
elements.definition: Creating a report of activities to address hazard risks, liability torts, financial risks, operational risks, social trends, competition, etc.

elements.name: Coordinate business unit and functional risk management activities
elements.definition: Coordinating risk management activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats. Specify the organization's objectives. Assign resources to project objectives.

elements.name: Ensure that each business unit/function follows the enterprise risk management process
elements.definition: Checking each business unit's/function's options and activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats.

elements.name: Ensure that each business unit/function follows the enterprise risk reporting process
elements.definition: Checking the reporting process of each business unit's/function's options and activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats.

elements.name: Manage business unit and function risk
elements.definition: Analyzing the threats a business unit/function faces to prioritize the controls it implements..

elements.name: Identify risks
elements.definition: Developing a timely and continuous process to identify activities that might hinder a project's goals.

elements.name: Assess risks using enterprise risk framework policies and procedures
elements.definition: Determining the possibility that a specified undesirable event will occur using established tools, implements, and frameworks. Use risk assessments to determine, for example, whether to undertake a particular venture, what rate of return a particular investment requires, and how to mitigate an activity's potential losses.

elements.name: Develop mitigation plans for risks
elements.definition: Developing possibilities and arrangements to improve opportunities and reduce deviations to project objectives.

elements.name: Assess adequacy of insurance coverage
elements.definition: Evaluating the changing needs for insurance coverage. Research available insurance providers and offerings.

elements.name: Implement mitigation plans for risks
elements.definition: Executing mitigation plans to improve opportunities and reduce deviations to project objectives.

elements.name: Monitor risks
elements.definition: Identifying, examining, and recognizing/justifying any improbability in investment decision making.

elements.name: Analyze risk activities and update plans
elements.definition: Examining the impact of risk activities in order to update the existing scheme of risk management. Analyze and substantiate the potential for adverse consequences to occur. Consider the risks associated with the activity and the methods available to manage those risks.

elements.name: Report on risk activities
elements.definition: Creating reports on risk activities, and communicating them to management. Prepare reports on the potential for adverse safety consequences.

elements.name: Manage compliance
elements.definition: Managing steps to confirm enduring compliance to industry regulations and government legislation.

elements.name: Establish compliance framework and policies
elements.definition: Developing a set of procedures detailing an organization's progress in complying with established guidelines, provisions, and legislation.

elements.name: Develop enterprise compliance policies and procedures
elements.definition: Creating a standardized approach to ethics and compliance. Have a programmatic approach for compliance that focuses on the definite risks the organization faces.

elements.name: Implement enterprise compliance activities
elements.definition: Implementing standardized for ethics and compliance. Have a programmatic approach, built from the top down, to enterprise compliance that focuses on the definite risks the organization faces.

elements.name: Manage internal audits
elements.definition: Managing accounts and prepare regular reports on financial performance.

elements.name: Maintain controls-related technologies and tools
elements.definition: Managing technologies and tools related to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data in order to ensure the security of the organization's information.

elements.name: Determine anticipated compliance to materials policies
elements.definition: Adhering to expiration dates and/or stocking policies of supplies.

elements.name: Manage regulatory compliance
elements.definition: Obeying laws, guidelines, strategies, and stipulations related to the business.

elements.name: Develop regulatory compliance procedures
elements.definition: Developing procedures and methodologies to comply with relevant laws and regulations of an organization's obedience to laws, guidelines, strategies and stipulations related to business.

elements.name: Identify applicable regulatory requirements
elements.definition: Determining the regulatory requirements that are most appropriate for the organization. Identify goals in order to follow the appropriate rules and regulations, guidelines, and strategies.

elements.name: Monitor the regulatory environment for changing or emerging regulations
elements.definition: Analyzing and overseeing the regulatory environment in order to spot any changing or emerging regulations. This process element calls upon the organization to monitor the regulatory environment for any new statutes, policies, and enactments issued by the respective government authorities or those which have been updated.

elements.name: Assess current compliance position and identify weaknesses or shortfalls therein
elements.definition: Evaluating current regulatory policies and regulations. Assess their performance. Make necessary changes.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Assess current compliance position, and identify weaknesses or shortfalls therein
elements.renamed_was: Assess current compliance position, and identify weaknesses or shortfalls therein

elements.name: Implement missing or stronger regulatory compliance controls and policies
elements.definition: Assessing the current policies and policies. Implement missing and necessary changes environmental changes, political changes, technological changes, etc.

elements.name: Monitor and test regulatory compliance position and existing controls
elements.definition: Monitoring, appraising, and evaluating the compliance position of the organization in order to fine-tune for effective remediation. Track efforts for handling regulatory and compliance requirements necessitated by law. Test the robustness of internal frameworks, procedures, and approaches for dealing with these requirements, in order to clearly identify any necessary changes.
elements.change_details: RENAME, WAS:Monitor and test, on an ongoing and scheduled basis, regulatory compliance position and existing controls, defining controls that should be added, removed, or modified as required
elements.renamed_was: Monitor and test, on an ongoing and scheduled basis, regulatory compliance position and existing controls, defining controls that should be added, removed, or modified as required

elements.name: Compile and communicate compliance scorecard(s)
elements.definition: Creating a graphical representation of metrics in order to communicate the general health of the organization in relation to risk and compliancy.

elements.name: Compile and communicate internal and regulatory compliance reports
elements.definition: Submitting compliance reports to regulatory agencies. These reports can be made to environmental, securities, or human resources agencies as stipulated by the local governing body.

elements.name: Maintain relationships with regulators as appropriate
elements.definition: Developing and preserving relationships with the regulators, without compromising the legal basis of the relationship.

elements.name: Manage remediation efforts
elements.definition: Administering the efforts and activities for remediation. This process element requires the organization to create plans for corrective action in collaboration with government agencies and pertinent professional services agencies which specialize in remediation efforts relevant to the organization's operations. Additionally, the organization needs to consult experts to validate the plan, determine resources allocation, resolve any legal concerns, and formulate a company-wide policy for remediation.

elements.name: Monitor medical staff compliance
elements.definition: Complying with CME requirements, credentials, state board certifications, disciplinary actions, etc. for Physicians, nurses, and other medical staff.

elements.name: Create remediation plans
elements.definition: Creating plans for remediation efforts. Make a plan to address a case of environmental adulteration. Identify and treat the adulteration so that the area will become operational again.

elements.name: Contact and confer with experts
elements.definition: Discussing and soliciting advice from experts for in order to incorporate their suggestion (regarding Create remediation plans [11201]).

elements.name: Identify/dedicate resources
elements.definition: Identifying and dedicating the resources for managing remediation efforts. Discern the resources needed for remediation efforts. Dispense with resources in a sound and well-reasoned manner.

elements.name: Investigate legal aspects
elements.definition: Examining regulatory and legislative frameworks. Obligate the organization to remediate any damages through compensations, fines, and any other remedial efforts necessitated to correct the situations. Analyze local environmental laws, binding international covenants, etc. in order to examine legal accuracy about the rules and procedures.

elements.name: Investigate damage cause
elements.definition: Studying the causes of damage, which could be environmental, physical, social, etc. at country level in order to institute better policies and regulations.

elements.name: Amend or create policy
elements.definition: Crafting a new framework of policies and procedures for deploying remediation efforts, or change existing policies and procedures. Adapt the policy structure to the context of the apposite national and international regulatory frameworks.

elements.name: Manage business resiliency
elements.definition: Including the processes required to rapidly adapt and respond to any internal or external opportunity, demand, disruption, or threat. Develop a more dynamic, strategic, and integrated approach to managing compliance obligations.

elements.name: Develop the business resilience strategy
elements.definition: Creating a strategy for rapidly adapting to disturbances. Maintain continuous business processes and protecting employees, assets, and overall brand equity.

elements.name: Perform continuous business operations planning
elements.definition: Developing plans to ensure continuous business operations.

elements.name: Test continuous business operations
elements.definition: Assessing ongoing activities within the organization that are not intended to stop except for in an emergency.

elements.name: Maintain continuous business operations
elements.definition: Evaluating business operations. Determine which activities generate revenues, perform best, and provide good returns.

elements.name: Share knowledge of specific risks across other parts of the organization
elements.definition: Sharing information about risks and resilience strategies of business operations across the organization so that prospective risks can be avoided.

elements.name: Manage External Relationships
elements.definition: Fostering external relationships with stakeholders of the entity, including investors, government and industry, the board of directors, and the general public. This is not related to customer management.

elements.name: Manage affiliation with university medical and fellow programs
elements.definition: Building and maintaining relationships with academic institutions in order to obtain interns, residents, and fellows, and facilitate research collaborations. Providers also provide feedback to institutions on curriculum and candidate performance.

elements.name: Build investor relationships
elements.definition: Creating a strategic management responsibility for integrating finance, communication, marketing, and securities law compliance. Allow the most effective two-way communication among the organization, the financial community, and other constituencies. Enlist the investor relations function to provide market intelligence to corporate management.

elements.name: Plan, build, and manage lender relations
elements.definition: Building and managing relations with bankers or lenders through strong products/services strategies that bankers would want to invest in. Foster a receptive environment for low rates of interest, easy access to loans, etc.

elements.name: Plan, build, and manage analyst relations
elements.definition: Creating and maintaining long-term relations with analysts. Involve analysts in strategy and product decisions in order to elicit valuable information.

elements.name: Communicate with shareholders
elements.definition: Practicing regular, transparent communication with shareholders through annual shareholders' meetings, quarterly earnings calls, shareholders letters, one-on-one emails or calls, etc.

elements.name: Manage government and industry relationships
elements.definition: Creating and maintaining relationships with government and industry representatives.

elements.name: Manage government relations
elements.definition: Persuading public and government policy at the local, regional, national, and global level (subject to government regulations).

elements.name: Assess relationships
elements.definition: Ascertaining how the business entity relates to all levels of government. Identify areas that needs further growth and resources to foster those relationships.

elements.name: Appoint responsible executives
elements.definition: Assigning executive level resources to manage, grow, and drive relationships with government bodies.

elements.name: Monitor relationships
elements.definition: Analyzing current relationships with government bodies and entities.

elements.name: Receive input from internal advisors
elements.definition: Garnering internal advice from an informal group in order to successfully maintain and advance relationships.

elements.name: Receive input from external advisors
elements.definition: Garnering third party advice from an informal group in order to successfully maintain and advance relationships.

elements.name: Liaise with authorities
elements.definition: Meeting with government heads and representatives.

elements.name: Manage relations with quasi-government bodies
elements.definition: Managing relations with quasi-governmental organizations, corporations, businesses, or any other agency that is treated by national laws and principles to be under the supervision of the government but also distinct and self-directed from the government.

elements.name: Establish relationships with agencies
elements.definition: Engaging government, regulatory, or industry agencies to establish relationships. Analyze steps and requirements necessary for inclusion, if needed.

elements.name: Respond to audit inquiries
elements.definition: Cooperating with auditors regarding potential or ongoing inquiries.

elements.name: Maintain documentation of contacts
elements.definition: Keeping a repository of documents that contain information about the network of partners, prospects and customers. Keep records up-to-date with routine reviews and modify as needed.

elements.name: Plan and manage meetings
elements.definition: Ensuring regular interaction between business entity and quasi-government bodies in order to maintain established relationships. Collect and record meeting data for further analysis and use.

elements.name: Manage relations with trade or industry groups
elements.definition: Managing relations with organizations established and financed by businesses that operate in a specific industry. Participate in public relations actions such as lobbying and publishing, advertising, education, and political donations.

elements.name: Evaluate the requirements for strategic relationships
elements.definition: Determining the requirements to enter in to an agreement with trade or industry agencies. Discover what activities or processes can be conducted to provide the best mutual outcome.

elements.name: Monitor the success of the partnerships
elements.definition: Analyzing current relationships with trade and industry groups. Ensure that the partnership in successful and make modifications where needed.

elements.name: Extend or change the relationships
elements.definition: Providing additional information or inclusion for third party trade or industry entities; or changing existing parameters to modify the current relationship. Communicate and execute changes.

elements.name: Manage lobby activities
elements.definition: Managing lobbying activities to affect government policies.

elements.name: Validate eligibility for grant funding and manage application process
elements.definition: Scouting, applying for, maintaining, and reporting on both organizational and government grants.

elements.name: Manage Relationship with Providers (Community and Independent)
elements.definition: Building relationships with community social workers, agencies, and schools to effectively manage and promote population health and wellness programs.

elements.name: Manage relations with board of directors
